scope: Current accepted insight-level difficulty only; no sample-total difficulty.

methodology.unit: One authored insight; difficulty is the number of distinct independent semantic inputs after expanding formula-derived metrics.
methodology.original_measurement: Original means a quantity/attribute present in the released source dataset. Renaming, unit conversion and adjustments of native measurements do not by themselves create another dimension.
methodology.derived_measurement: Expand recoverable injections and computed metrics to their required native or independent-equivalent inputs; deduplicate shared parents. Native quantities retain their native identity after adjustment.
methodology.geometry: Latitude and longitude are one spatial input. Required ordering is counted; an index is not automatically a separate clock-time input.
methodology.identity: Count the native inputs that distinguish required units. Establish point ownership using entity identity before time/position segmentation, retaining that input even in a single-owner case. A reconstructed ID remains an analysis unit in the lineage, but does not add a dimension on top of its verified native parents. Preserve independent grouping information when its necessity and independence are proven; otherwise mark pending.
methodology.time: An observed point-timestamp stream supplies departure period and elapsed duration once. Distinct event time columns remain distinct when the claim needs both. Fixed sampling constants are not extra fields.
methodology.external_reference: An independently supplied coastline/road/route/land-use reference counts when required, separately from observed GPS.
methodology.case_union: Compute case dependencies as the union AFTER independent insight annotation. Do not force insight annotations to reproduce the old case-level union.
methodology.annotation_method: Every counted field in all 125 cases / 423 insights is classified against released source columns, an explicit independent-input explanation, a full-table verified derivation, or an explicit pending-source question. Pending is not proof of independence.
methodology.added_independent_measurement: An injected field recoverable from original inputs is expanded to those inputs and deduplicated. A genuinely independent injected attribute counts equivalently to one native input. Counting equivalence does not change source provenance. Lack of a located formula alone is not proof of independence.
methodology.field_names: original_field_dependencies contains only verified source-native semantic inputs; additional_field_dependencies contains only justified independent-equivalent inputs; pending_field_dependencies is separate and provisional.
methodology.gps_position: Latitude and longitude are one spatial input, not two. Raw GPS and an independent matched-road reference remain distinct only when both are required, such as GPS-offset comparisons.
methodology.ordering: Count necessary observation order. If timestamp already provides that same order, do not count an index again.
methodology.revision_scope: All dataset families and all current counted fields; recursive expansion, alias deduplication, and strict source-status separation.
methodology.band_revision: User-defined 2026-10-08: Low 1–3; Medium 4; High 5; Very high 6+.
methodology.recoverability: Use semantic reconstruction at delivered precision and verify all records, including inverse recovery when a constructor assigned an output first. Do not infer derivation from label/ID strings or correlation alone.
methodology.pending: A working difficulty including unresolved leaves is provisional, not a confirmed native-field count. Report resolved and pending distributions separately. User confirmation must state the actual native parents or justify an independent exception.
methodology.native_reference_evidence: Native-column catalogs identify released quantity types. Constructed/adjusted values are not falsely presented as original observations.
methodology.user_native_input_decisions_20261008: WorldTrace speed statistics share GPS/time roots; distances and durations are not double-counted alongside those roots. point_index is structural order, not an extra input; WorldTrace region strings are descriptions. These explicit counting decisions are separate from numeric reconstruction, which this repair performs for WorldTrace 03. Missing delivered support is disclosed in leaf availability notes.
methodology.spatial_labels_20261008: User-directed counting convention: area, place and spatial-classification labels describe GPS/location and do not add independent inputs. Use the position of the classified object (task or stand where appropriate), deduplicating the same position. Preserve MTL native purpose and other genuine original attributes, as well as already required independent map/reference inputs. This convention does not claim polygon/semantic reconstruction or repair the separate pending land-use mismatches.
methodology.time_field_adjudication_20261008: After official-source review, the user explicitly accepted Porto 04/06 request_time (06: call_time), LaDe 05 deadline, and LaDe 06 available_time as equivalent native inputs. Their actual origin remains an additional constructed event or constraint. Porto 05/07 request_time exactly aliases trip start and is normalized to native departure_time. This is a case-scoped adjudication; other unresolved time fields are not automatically accepted. See results/dataset_quality/time_field_resolution_20261008/policy.json.
methodology.remaining_time_field_recovery_20261008: The subsequent user instruction requires official-definition review followed by semantic deletion/recovery checks for the remaining time fields. Verified aliases and full-table recoveries expand to retained inputs and deduplicate; additional events or variable time streams not identifiable from retained source-native fields are accepted as independent_equivalent. Copies and derived durations/speeds are excluded as circular recovery evidence. The 13 reviewed case-specific fields, official sources, quantitative checks and explicit equivalent decisions are recorded in results/dataset_quality/remaining_time_field_resolution_20261008/policy.json and case_checks.json. All observation data and authored insights remain unchanged.
methodology.identity_label_recovery_20261008: Case-scoped review covers 21 remaining grouping/label definitions: 14 verified recoveries expand to required native or accepted equivalent inputs; 3 independently supplied matching/route/leg partitions remain equivalent inputs; 4 MTL land-use definitions remain pending official-map consistency. Retain necessary owner and task/trajectory identity, including regional namespaces for locally reused courier codes. Spatial descriptions add no separate attribute; preserve MTL native trip purpose. See results/dataset_quality/identity_label_resolution_20261008/policy.json and case_checks.json. All observation data and authored insights remain unchanged.
methodology.full_plot_evidence_review_20261008: All 423 insights in 125 cases were visually reviewed against every attached figure, including coordinate axes, legends, filters, substantive companion maps and annotations, together with description/evidence. Required input sets are explicitly recorded before recursive native-root expansion. Decorative basemaps are excluded. Latest 16 human decisions and older 13 decisions are preserved; extensions required by the full-figure scope are explained, with unresolved scope choices queued separately. No observation, authored insight, description/evidence, code or figure was changed. See results/dataset_quality/full_plot_evidence_review_20261008/decisions.json.
methodology.final_human_confirmation_20261009: All seven remaining items were explicitly confirmed in the final export. WorldTrace 19 insight 2 counts GPS, timestamp and trajectory identity (3); the shared matched-road map is retained as context outside this insight counting scope. LaDe 24 insight 2 retains fclass (6) and LaDe 25 insight 2 retains legacy evidence fclass (5). Four MTL field sets/counts are human-confirmed while source-map consistency remains an acknowledged provenance note, not a pending difficulty decision. No source status is falsely upgraded to verified-native or independent-equivalent. All 36 historical decision records are retained across three immutable exports, covering 30 distinct insights.
methodology.worldtrace04_07_reconstruction_20261008: WorldTrace 04/07 deliver case-local reconstructed GPS/time data, with current plotted metrics independently verified. The original reconstruction covers 16 + 68 trajectories; the user-authorized sample 04 expansion supersedes it with 48 + 68 trajectories when applied. WorldTrace 07 yaw-change denotes a GPS horizontal bearing-change proxy and route-indirectness is GPS path length divided by endpoint distance; both expand to GPS. Case metadata and provenance disclose reconstruction, not original observation recovery. See the reconstruction and superseding expansion reports in authorized_case_data_repairs.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def fit_corridor(frame):
    """Find the dominant GPS ridge without timestamps, speed or draught.

    Polynomial candidates come from geometrically well-conditioned tracks;
    the final score uses all positions. Neither track length nor longitude
    span is a peripheral/corridor classification rule.
    """
    x=frame['lon'].to_numpy();y=frame['lat'].to_numpy();candidates=[]
    for _,group in frame.groupby('trajectory_id'):
        if group.lon.max()-group.lon.min()>.12 and len(group)>=4:
            curve=np.polyfit(group.lon,group.lat,2)
            residual=np.abs(y-np.polyval(curve,x))*111.32
            candidates.append((np.count_nonzero(residual<.6),curve))
    curve=max(candidates,key=lambda row:row[0])[1]
    for _ in range(3):
        inlier=np.abs(y-np.polyval(curve,x))*111.32<.6
        curve=np.polyfit(x[inlier],y[inlier],2)
    # A fixed 0.8-km proximity band is stated on the map. The centerline is
    # estimated from observed coordinates, not an external lane attribute.
    return curve,.8/111.32

d=df.copy()
curve,half=fit_corridor(d)
# Lateral offset is the absolute north-south latitude residual, converted
# with 111.32 km/degree. It is not shortest geodesic distance to the curve.
d['lateral_offset_km']=np.abs(d.lat-np.polyval(curve,d.lon))*111.32
d['within_corridor']=d.lateral_offset_km.le(.8)
spatial=d.groupby('trajectory_id').agg(within_corridor_share=('within_corridor','mean'),median_lateral_offset_km=('lateral_offset_km','median'))
spatial['zone']=np.where(spatial.within_corridor_share.ge(.6),'Corridor vicinity','Outside corridor')
d['zone']=d.trajectory_id.map(spatial.zone)

d['timestamp']=pd.to_datetime(d['timestamp'])
d['period']=(d['timestamp'].dt.hour//4)*4
profile=d.groupby('period')['trajectory_id'].nunique().reindex([0,4,8,12],fill_value=0).rename('active_vessels').to_frame()
zone_counts=d.groupby(['period','zone']).trajectory_id.nunique().unstack(fill_value=0)
profile['corridor_vessels']=zone_counts['Corridor vicinity']
profile['outside_corridor_vessels']=zone_counts['Outside corridor']
vessel_offsets=d.groupby(['period','trajectory_id']).lateral_offset_km.median()
profile['median_vessel_lateral_offset_km']=vessel_offsets.groupby('period').median()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def fit_corridor(frame):
    """Find the dominant GPS ridge without timestamps, speed or draught.

    Polynomial candidates come from geometrically well-conditioned tracks;
    the final score uses all positions. Neither track length nor longitude
    span is a peripheral/corridor classification rule.
    """
    x=frame['lon'].to_numpy();y=frame['lat'].to_numpy();candidates=[]
    for _,group in frame.groupby('trajectory_id'):
        if group.lon.max()-group.lon.min()>.12 and len(group)>=4:
            curve=np.polyfit(group.lon,group.lat,2)
            residual=np.abs(y-np.polyval(curve,x))*111.32
            candidates.append((np.count_nonzero(residual<.6),curve))
    curve=max(candidates,key=lambda row:row[0])[1]
    for _ in range(3):
        inlier=np.abs(y-np.polyval(curve,x))*111.32<.6
        curve=np.polyfit(x[inlier],y[inlier],2)
    # A fixed 0.8-km proximity band is stated on the map. The centerline is
    # estimated from observed coordinates, not an external lane attribute.
    return curve,.8/111.32

d=df.copy()
curve,half=fit_corridor(d)
# Lateral offset is the absolute north-south latitude residual, converted
# with 111.32 km/degree. It is not shortest geodesic distance to the curve.
d['lateral_offset_km']=np.abs(d.lat-np.polyval(curve,d.lon))*111.32
d['within_corridor']=d.lateral_offset_km.le(.8)
spatial=d.groupby('trajectory_id').agg(within_corridor_share=('within_corridor','mean'),median_lateral_offset_km=('lateral_offset_km','median'))
spatial['zone']=np.where(spatial.within_corridor_share.ge(.6),'Corridor vicinity','Outside corridor')
d['zone']=d.trajectory_id.map(spatial.zone)

vessels=d.groupby('trajectory_id').agg(zone=('zone','first'),draught=('draught','first')); print(vessels.groupby('zone').draught.agg(['count','median','min','max'])); vessels.boxplot(column='draught',by='zone'); plt.show()

import math
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

d = df.copy()
axes = {'Bornholmsgat': ((14.10, 55.18), (14.75, 55.43)), 'Great Belt': ((10.92, 54.95), (10.94, 55.43))}
crossing_ids = {'bornholmsgat_vessel_16_track', 'bornholmsgat_vessel_17_track', 'bornholmsgat_vessel_18_track'}
rows = []
for corridor, (start, end) in axes.items():
 q = d[(d['corridor'] == corridor) & (~d['trajectory_id'].isin(crossing_ids))].copy()
 mean_lat = math.radians((start[1] + end[1]) / 2)
 x = (q['lon'].to_numpy() - start[0]) * 111.32 * math.cos(mean_lat)
 y = (q['lat'].to_numpy() - start[1]) * 110.57
 vx = (end[0] - start[0]) * 111.32 * math.cos(mean_lat); vy = (end[1] - start[1]) * 110.57
 length = math.hypot(vx, vy); cross = x * (-vy / length) + y * (vx / length)
 q['cross_km'] = cross
 medians = q.groupby('trajectory_id')['cross_km'].median()
 rows.extend((corridor, value) for value in medians)
w = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['corridor', 'cross_km'])
print(w.groupby('corridor')['cross_km'].quantile([.05, .5, .95]))
w.boxplot(column='cross_km', by='corridor', showfliers=False)
plt.suptitle(''); plt.title('Cross-corridor positions of aligned tracks'); plt.ylabel('Median cross-track position (km)'); plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
points = pd.read_csv(dataset_path)
points['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(points['timestamp'])
landmarks = pd.read_csv(Path(dataset_path).with_name('landmarks.csv')).set_index('landmark_id')
ferries = pd.read_csv(user_dataset_path)
ports = landmarks.loc[['grenaa', 'anholt_port', 'varberg']]
visits = []
for trip, group in points.groupby('trajectory_id'):
    ordered = group.sort_values('timestamp')
    ends = []
    for row in [ordered.iloc[0], ordered.iloc[-1]]:
        # A local distance approximation is sufficient for nearest-reference
        # assignment; Grenaa and Varberg are offshore approach references.
        d2 = ((ports.lon-row.lon)*np.cos(np.radians(row.lat)))**2 + (ports.lat-row.lat)**2
        ends.append(ports.loc[d2.idxmin(), 'landmark_name'])
    visits.append({'trajectory_id': trip, 'vessel_id': ordered.vessel_id.iloc[0],
                   'departure': ordered.timestamp.iloc[0], 'from': ends[0], 'to': ends[1]})
service_endpoints = pd.DataFrame(visits).merge(ferries[['vessel_id','ferry_name']], on='vessel_id', validate='many_to_one')
print(service_endpoints[['ferry_name','from','to']].value_counts().to_string())

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
points = pd.read_csv(dataset_path)
points['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(points['timestamp'])
landmarks = pd.read_csv(Path(dataset_path).with_name('landmarks.csv')).set_index('landmark_id')
def fit_turns(points):
    """Estimate the dominant southern turning vertex from east-oriented arms."""
    frame=pd.DataFrame(points);result=[]
    for trip,g in frame[frame.vessel_id.eq('ferry_stena_nautica')].groupby('trajectory_id'):
        if g[g.lon.between(11.45,11.65)].lat.mean()>float(landmarks.loc['anholt', 'lat']):continue
        g=g.sort_values('point_index')
        if g.lon.iloc[0]>g.lon.iloc[-1]:g=g.iloc[::-1]
        x,y=g.lon.to_numpy(),g.lat.to_numpy()
        # Circular COG change locates the turn; fit GPS arms beyond its sampled
        # smoothing window to estimate the physical vertex.
        cog=g.cog.to_numpy();angle=np.abs((cog[2:]-cog[:-2]+180)%360-180)
        eligible=np.flatnonzero((x[1:-1]>11.15)&(x[1:-1]<11.9));i=eligible[np.argmax(angle[eligible])]+1
        left=np.polyfit(x[i-5:i-1],y[i-5:i-1],1);right=np.polyfit(x[i+2:i+6],y[i+2:i+6],1)
        lon=(right[1]-left[1])/(left[0]-right[0]);lat=np.polyval(left,lon)
        result.append(dict(trajectory_id=trip,period='later' if pd.to_datetime(g.timestamp).min()>=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-18') else 'earlier',lon=float(lon),lat=float(lat)))
    return pd.DataFrame(result)

turns = fit_turns(points)
mean_turn_lat = turns.groupby('period').lat.mean()
# North-south displacement on the same spherical Earth as the motion checks.
turn_shift_south_km = float(np.radians(mean_turn_lat['earlier']-mean_turn_lat['later'])*6371.0088)
print(turns.to_string(index=False))
print(f'Mean dominant turning vertex shifts south by {turn_shift_south_km:.3f} km.')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
points=pd.read_csv(dataset_path).sort_values(['trajectory_id','point_index']); vessels=pd.read_csv(user_dataset_path); points['timestamp']=pd.to_datetime(points.timestamp)
delta=points.groupby('trajectory_id').cog.diff(); interval=points.groupby('trajectory_id').timestamp.diff().dt.total_seconds()/60; points['short_cog_change']=(abs((delta+180)%360-180)>5)&(interval<=7)
trips=points.groupby('trajectory_id').agg(vessel_id=('vessel_id','first'),start=('timestamp','min'),end=('timestamp','max'),short_cog_changes=('short_cog_change','sum')).reset_index().merge(vessels,on='vessel_id'); trips['duration_hours']=(trips.end-trips.start).dt.total_seconds()/3600; trips['short_cog_change_rate_per_hour']=trips.short_cog_changes/trips.duration_hours
hour=trips.start.dt.hour; trips['period']=np.select([(hour>=4)&(hour<9),(hour>=9)&(hour<14),(hour>=14)&(hour<19)],['early_morning','midday','late_afternoon'],default='evening_night'); trips['small_vessel']=(trips.length_m<70)&(trips.width_m<15)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = df.copy()
d['receipt_time'] = pd.to_datetime(d['receipt_time']); d['sign_time'] = pd.to_datetime(d['sign_time'])
for c in ['receipt_lng','receipt_lat','poi_lng','poi_lat']: d[c] = pd.to_numeric(d[c])
def haversine(lon1,lat1,lon2,lat2):
    p1,p2=np.radians(lat1),np.radians(lat2); dp=np.radians(lat2-lat1); dl=np.radians(lon2-lon1)
    a=np.sin(dp/2)**2+np.cos(p1)*np.cos(p2)*np.sin(dl/2)**2
    return 6371.0088*2*np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a),np.sqrt(1-a))
d['destination_distance_km']=haversine(d.receipt_lng,d.receipt_lat,d.poi_lng,d.poi_lat)
sparse=d.groupby(['ds','receipt_time']).filter(lambda q: len(q)==4).sort_values(['ds','receipt_time','sign_time'])
checks=sparse.groupby(['ds','receipt_time']).apply(lambda q:q.iloc[:2].destination_distance_km.min()>q.iloc[2:].destination_distance_km.max())
print('Sparse batches:',len(checks),'farther-before-closer batches:',int(checks.sum()))

        values.append({'ds': ds, 'distance': np.hypot(np.diff(segment['lng']), np.diff(segment['lat'])).sum() if len(segment) > 1 else 0}); previous_time = row['sign_time']
summary = pd.DataFrame(values); fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
for xpos, (ds, q) in enumerate(summary.groupby('ds')):
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(q), xpos) + np.random.default_rng(xpos).normal(0,.05,len(q)), q['distance'], alpha=.7); ax.hlines(q['distance'].mean(), xpos-.2, xpos+.2, linewidth=3)

dependency_annotation.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def allocation(df, user_df):
    import matplotlib.dates as mdates
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch

    q = user_df.sort_values('gps_time').copy()
    stamps = pd.to_datetime(q.gps_time, format='mixed')
    minutes = stamps.diff().dt.total_seconds()/60
    totals = minutes.groupby(q.activity_state).sum()
    colors = {'travelling': '#397aa7', 'near_delivery_location': '#c7813e'}
    fig, (timeline, total) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(11.8, 6.3), constrained_layout=True,
        gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [1, 1.1]})
    # Each row's state describes its PRECEDING GPS interval.
    for i in range(1, len(q)):
        timeline.barh(0, mdates.date2num(stamps.iloc[i])-mdates.date2num(stamps.iloc[i-1]),
            left=mdates.date2num(stamps.iloc[i-1]), height=.55,
            color=colors[q.activity_state.iloc[i]], linewidth=0)
    timeline.set(ylim=(-.6, 1.1), yticks=[], xlabel='Local Shanghai time',
        title='Observed workday activity sequence')
    timeline.xaxis_date()
    timeline.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%H:%M'))
    timeline.legend(handles=[Patch(color=colors['travelling'], label='Travelling'),
        Patch(color=colors['near_delivery_location'], label='Near delivery locations')],
        loc='upper center', ncol=2, frameon=False)
    values = [float(totals['travelling']), float(totals['near_delivery_location'])]
    total.barh(['Travelling', 'Near delivery locations'], values,
        color=list(colors.values()), height=.55)
    for y, v in enumerate(values): total.text(v+3, y, f'{v:.0f} min', va='center')
    total.set(xlim=(0, max(values)*1.18), xlabel='Total observed time (minutes)',
        title='Time near delivery locations exceeds travel time')
    for ax in [timeline, total]:
        ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    return {'travelling_minutes': round(values[0], 1), 'near_delivery_minutes': round(values[1], 1)}

evidence = allocation(df, user_df)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def visit_counts(df, user_df):
    ordered = df.sort_values('visit_duration_min')
    longest = ordered.iloc[-1]
    colors = ['#b75858' if r.visit_id == longest.visit_id else '#4d8977'
        if r.completed_deliveries > 1 else '#9aa7b1' for r in ordered.itertuples()]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.6, 7.0), constrained_layout=True)
    ax.barh(ordered.visit_id, ordered.visit_duration_min, color=colors, height=.68)
    for y, row in enumerate(ordered.itertuples()):
        n = int(row.completed_deliveries)
        label = f"{n} {'delivery' if n == 1 else 'deliveries'}"
        if row.visit_id == longest.visit_id: label += ' · longest visit'
        ax.text(row.visit_duration_min+.25, y, label, va='center', fontsize=10,
            fontweight='bold' if row.visit_id == longest.visit_id else 'normal')
    ax.set(xlim=(0, longest.visit_duration_min*1.46), xlabel='Visit duration (minutes)',
        ylabel='Visit', title='Duration and completed deliveries for every visit')
    ax.set_axisbelow(True); ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=.18)
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    return {'longest_visit_id': str(longest.visit_id), 'duration_minutes': float(longest.visit_duration_min),
        'completed_deliveries': int(longest.completed_deliveries)}

evidence = visit_counts(df, user_df)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def route_orientation(df,user_df):
    q=user_df.sort_values('point_index');xy=q[['lng','lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2,111]
    shifted=xy-xy.mean(axis=0)
    area=float(.5*np.sum(shifted[:-1,0]*shifted[1:,1]-shifted[1:,0]*shifted[:-1,1]))
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,7),constrained_layout=True)
    ax.plot(q.lng,q.lat,color='#608aa3',lw=1.3)
    for name,s in q[q.route_phase.eq('cluster_service')].groupby('route_section'):
        ax.plot(s.lng,s.lat,lw=2,label=name)
    for i in np.linspace(0,len(q)-8,16,dtype=int):
        ax.annotate('',xy=(q.iloc[i+7].lng,q.iloc[i+7].lat),xytext=(q.iloc[i].lng,q.iloc[i].lat),arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'->','color':'#283e4d'})
    ax.set(xlabel='Longitude',ylabel='Latitude',title='Clockwise street route with local service loops')
    ax.set_aspect(1/np.cos(np.radians(q.lat.mean())));ax.ticklabel_format(useOffset=False);ax.legend(fontsize=8)
    return {'signed_area_km2':area,'route_orientation':'clockwise' if area<0 else 'counterclockwise','immediate_reversal_count':int(q.directional_change_deg.ge(135).sum())}

evidence=route_orientation(df,user_df)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def ahead_before_behind(df,user_df):
    tasks=df.reset_index(drop=True);q=user_df.sort_values('point_index').reset_index(drop=True)
    xy=q[['lng','lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2,111]
    dest=tasks[['task_lng','task_lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2,111]
    starts=pd.to_datetime(tasks.accept_time,format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
    ends=pd.to_datetime(tasks.completion_time,format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
    times=pd.to_datetime(q.gps_time,format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy();found={}
    for i in range(len(q)-1):
        heading=xy[i+1]-xy[i]
        if np.linalg.norm(heading)<1e-9:continue
        vectors=dest-xy[i];dots=vectors@heading;distance=np.linalg.norm(vectors,axis=1)
        pending=(starts<=times[i])&(ends>times[i])
        eligible=(pending&(dots>0))[:,None]&(pending&(dots<0))[None,:]&(distance[:,None]>distance[None,:])
        for a,b in zip(*np.where(eligible)):
            key=tuple(sorted((int(a),int(b))))
            if key in found:continue
            found[key]={'cluster':str(tasks.service_cluster.iloc[a]),
                'ahead_task_id':str(tasks.task_id.iloc[a]),'behind_task_id':str(tasks.task_id.iloc[b]),
                'comparison_time':str(q.gps_time.iloc[i]),'point_index':int(q.point_index.iloc[i]),
                'ahead_distance_km':float(distance[a]),'behind_distance_km':float(distance[b]),
                'ahead_completion_time':str(tasks.completion_time.iloc[a]),'behind_completion_time':str(tasks.completion_time.iloc[b]),
                'outcome':'Ahead farther first' if ends[a]<ends[b] else 'Behind nearer first'}
    pairs=list(found.values());positive=[r for r in pairs if r['outcome']=='Ahead farther first']
    reverse=[r for r in pairs if r['outcome']=='Behind nearer first']
    assert positive and reverse
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,5.2),constrained_layout=True)
    counts=[len(positive),len(reverse)];axes[0].bar(['Ahead farther\nfirst','Behind nearer\nfirst'],counts,color=['#588677','#bd8452'])
    for i,n in enumerate(counts):axes[0].text(i,n+.3,str(n),ha='center')
    axes[0].set(ylim=(0,max(counts)*1.2),ylabel='Distinct eligible task pairs',title='Full route: all accepted pending tasks')
    for ax,options,label in zip(axes[1:],[positive,reverse],['Typical order','Counterexample']):
        pair=min(options,key=lambda r:r['ahead_distance_km']+r['behind_distance_km'])
        i=pair['point_index'];origin=xy[i];heading=xy[i+1]-origin
        indices=[tasks.index[tasks.task_id.eq(pair[k])][0] for k in ['ahead_task_id','behind_task_id']]
        locations=(dest[indices]-origin)*1000;line=(xy-origin)*1000
        span=max(120,float(np.max(np.abs(locations)))*1.3)
        ax.plot(line[:,0],line[:,1],color='#ccd4d9',lw=1,zorder=0)
        ax.scatter([0],[0],marker='*',s=130,color='black',label='Courier',zorder=4)
        arrow=heading/np.linalg.norm(heading)*span*.35
        ax.annotate('',xy=arrow,xytext=(0,0),arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'->','color':'black','lw':2})
        perpendicular=np.array([-heading[1],heading[0]])/np.linalg.norm(heading)*span*2
        ax.plot([-perpendicular[0],perpendicular[0]],[-perpendicular[1],perpendicular[1]],
            '--',color='#8e969b',lw=.9)
        ax.text(.02,.02,'Star: courier; arrow: heading\nDashed line: front/back boundary',
            transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=7,va='bottom')
        for j,(pos,index) in enumerate(zip(locations,indices)):
            name='Ahead / farther' if j==0 else 'Behind / nearer'
            ax.scatter(*pos,s=70,color=['#588677','#bd8452'][j],zorder=3)
            text=f'{name}\n{tasks.task_id.iloc[index]}: '+pd.Timestamp(tasks.completion_time.iloc[index]).strftime('%H:%M:%S')
            ax.annotate(text,pos,xytext=(5,7),textcoords='offset points',fontsize=8)
        ax.set(xlim=(-span,span),ylim=(-span,span),aspect='equal',xlabel='East of courier (m)',ylabel='North of courier (m)',
            title=label+' at '+pd.Timestamp(pair['comparison_time']).strftime('%H:%M:%S'))
        ax.grid(alpha=.15)
    return {'verified_pairs':len(positive),'eligible_pairs':len(pairs),'counterexample_pairs':len(reverse),
        'ahead_farther_completed_first_share':len(positive)/len(pairs),
        'clusters_with_pattern':len({x['cluster'] for x in positive}),'pair_evidence':pairs,
        'comparison_rule':'Whole route, all accepted and uncompleted tasks; each unordered task pair counted once at its first qualifying GPS instant. Heading uses the next moving GPS segment. No cluster or completion-order preselection.'}

evidence=ahead_before_behind(df,user_df)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def phase_movements(df,user_df):
    # Common 30-second windows prevent irregular raw GPS spacing from being
    # mistaken for a behavioural difference. These are analysis samples only.
    rows=[]
    for name,q in user_df.groupby('route_section',sort=False):
        stamps=pd.to_datetime(q.gps_time,format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
        elapsed=(stamps-stamps[0])/1e9;grid=np.arange(0,elapsed[-1],30)
        if len(grid)<3:continue
        xy=np.array([np.interp(grid,elapsed,q.lng)*95.2,np.interp(grid,elapsed,q.lat)*111]).T
        delta=np.diff(xy,axis=0);head=np.arctan2(delta[:,0],delta[:,1]);turn=abs((np.diff(head)+np.pi)%(2*np.pi)-np.pi)*180/np.pi
        phase='Service clusters' if name.startswith('cluster') else 'Connections'
        rows.extend({'phase':phase,'distance_km':float(length),'turn_deg':float(angle)} for length,angle in zip(np.linalg.norm(delta,axis=1)[1:],turn))
    d=pd.DataFrame(rows);groups=d.groupby('phase')
    rates={name:float(q.turn_deg.ge(30).sum()/q.distance_km.sum()) for name,q in groups}
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.8),constrained_layout=True)
    labels=['Service clusters','Connections']
    axes[0].bar(labels,[rates[x] for x in labels],color=['#c38651','#65899f'])
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Turns ≥30° per kilometre',title='More turning per travelled distance')
    axes[1].boxplot([d[d.phase.eq(x)].distance_km*1000 for x in labels],tick_labels=labels)
    axes[1].set(ylabel='Displacement in a common 30-second window (m)',title='Shorter movements during clustered service')
    return {'comparison_interval_seconds':30,'turns_ge30_per_km':rates,'median_30s_distance_km':groups.distance_km.median().to_dict(),
            'mean_30s_direction_change_deg':groups.turn_deg.mean().to_dict()}

evidence=phase_movements(df,user_df)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def pending_timeline(df,user_df):
    import matplotlib.dates as mdates
    d=df.copy();d.accept_time=pd.to_datetime(d.accept_time);d.pickup_time=pd.to_datetime(d.pickup_time)
    times=pd.date_range(pd.Timestamp(user_df.gps_time.iloc[0]),pd.Timestamp(user_df.gps_time.iloc[-1]),freq='1min')
    pending=np.array([((d.accept_time<=t)&(d.pickup_time>t)).sum() for t in times])
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,6),sharex=True,constrained_layout=True)
    axes[0].plot(times,pending);axes[0].axhline(7,color='gray',ls='--');axes[0].set(ylabel='Pending pickups',title='Workload reconstructed from all task events')
    axes[1].scatter(d.accept_time,np.ones(len(d)),marker='|',label='Accepted');axes[1].scatter(d.pickup_time,np.zeros(len(d)),marker='|',label='Completed')
    axes[1].set(yticks=[0,1],yticklabels=['Completed','Accepted'],xlabel='Local Shanghai time');axes[1].legend()
    axes[1].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%H:%M'))
    active=times>=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-10 12:00:00')
    return {'modal_afternoon_pending':int(pd.Series(pending[active]).mode().iloc[0]),'afternoon_share_between_6_and_9':float(((pending[active]>=6)&(pending[active]<=9)).mean())}

evidence=pending_timeline(df,user_df)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def close_task_priority(df,user_df):
    d=df.copy();d.accept_time=pd.to_datetime(d.accept_time);d.pickup_time=pd.to_datetime(d.pickup_time)
    stamps=pd.to_datetime(user_df.gps_time,format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy();origin=stamps[0];stamps=stamps-origin
    pairs=[]
    # Define proximity before observing completion order; selecting only quick
    # completions here would bias the result toward "new nearby first".
    for new in d.itertuples():
        moment=new.accept_time.value-origin;pos=np.array([np.interp(moment,stamps,user_df.lng),np.interp(moment,stamps,user_df.lat)])
        near=np.linalg.norm((np.array([new.pickup_lng,new.pickup_lat])-pos)*[95.2,111])
        for old in d[(d.accept_time<new.accept_time)&(d.pickup_time>new.accept_time)].itertuples():
            far=np.linalg.norm((np.array([old.pickup_lng,old.pickup_lat])-pos)*[95.2,111])
            if far>near+.25 and near<1.0:
                pairs.append({'new_task':new.pickup_task_id,'older_task':old.pickup_task_id,'new_distance_km':float(near),'old_distance_km':float(far),'new_first':bool(new.pickup_time<old.pickup_time)})
    pairs=pd.DataFrame(pairs)
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.8),constrained_layout=True)
    axes[0].scatter(d.distance_from_courier_at_accept_km,d.wait_after_accept_min,alpha=.7)
    exceptions=d[d.distance_from_courier_at_accept_km.ge(.4)&d.wait_after_accept_min.le(30)]
    axes[0].scatter(exceptions.distance_from_courier_at_accept_km,exceptions.wait_after_accept_min,
        facecolors='none',edgecolors='#bd8452',s=110,label='Distance ≥0.4 km, wait ≤30 min')
    axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)
    axes[0].set(xlabel='Distance at acceptance (km)',ylabel='Acceptance-to-pickup delay (min)',title='All task observations')
    counts=pairs.new_first.value_counts().reindex([True,False],fill_value=0)
    axes[1].bar(['New nearby first','Older distant first'],counts,color=['#588677','#bd8452'])
    for x, count in enumerate(counts):
        axes[1].text(x, count+1, str(int(count)), ha='center', va='bottom')
    axes[1].set_ylim(0, max(counts)*1.15)
    axes[1].set(ylabel='Distinct simultaneously pending task pairs',title='Compare both distances at the same acceptance time')
    return {'distinct_pairs':len(pairs),'new_tasks_with_comparisons':pairs.new_task.nunique(),
            'new_nearby_completed_first_share':float(pairs.new_first.mean()),
            'older_distant_completed_first_pairs':int((~pairs.new_first).sum()),
            'counterexample_pairs':pairs.loc[~pairs.new_first,['new_task','older_task']].to_dict('records'),
            'farther_quick_pickups':int(len(exceptions)),
            'close_long_wait_pickups':int((d.distance_from_courier_at_accept_km.lt(.4)&d.wait_after_accept_min.gt(30)).sum()),
            'nearby_radius_km':1.0,
            'selection_rule':'All accepted pickup tasks; nearby <1.0 km and older pending task at least 0.25 km farther at the same acceptance time. No completion-delay prefilter. The same 1 km nearby radius is used for the completion pause.'}

evidence=close_task_priority(df,user_df)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def completion_pause(df,user_df):
    import matplotlib.dates as mdates
    start=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-10 14:05:00');end=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-10 15:20:00')
    d=df.copy();d.accept_time=pd.to_datetime(d.accept_time);d.pickup_time=pd.to_datetime(d.pickup_time)
    pending=d[(d.accept_time<=start)&(d.pickup_time>end)]
    stamps=pd.to_datetime(user_df.gps_time,format='mixed');q=user_df[(stamps>=start)&(stamps<=end)]
    center=q[['lng','lat']].mean().to_numpy();distance=np.linalg.norm((pending[['pickup_lng','pickup_lat']].to_numpy()-center)*[95.2,111],axis=1)
    assert (distance<1.0).all()
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.8),constrained_layout=True)
    axes[0].scatter(pending.pickup_lng,pending.pickup_lat,label='Pending locations',color='#5485a1')
    axes[0].scatter([center[0]],[center[1]],marker='*',s=160,color='#b6533d',edgecolors='white',zorder=5,label='Courier during pause')
    axes[0].set(xlabel='Longitude',ylabel='Latitude',title='Seven accepted tasks remain in the surrounding area');axes[0].legend(fontsize=8);axes[0].ticklabel_format(useOffset=False)
    axes[1].scatter(d.accept_time,np.ones(len(d)),marker='|',label='Accepted');axes[1].scatter(d.pickup_time,np.zeros(len(d)),marker='|',label='Completed')
    axes[1].axvspan(start,end,alpha=.2,color='gray');axes[1].set(yticks=[0,1],yticklabels=['Completed','Accepted'],xlabel='Local Shanghai time',title='75-minute pause with no task events')
    axes[1].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%H:%M'))
    return {'pause_start':str(start),'pause_end':str(end),'pause_minutes':75,'pending_throughout_pause':len(pending),'nearby_radius_km':1.0,
            'pending_distance_min_km':float(distance.min()),'pending_distance_max_km':float(distance.max()),
            'acceptances_during_pause':int(d.accept_time.between(start,end).sum()),'completions_during_pause':int(d.pickup_time.between(start,end).sum())}

evidence=completion_pause(df,user_df)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def visit_distribution(df):
    counts = pd.crosstab(df.completed_deliveries, df.aoi_type, normalize='columns')
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5, 5.7), constrained_layout=True)
    counts.reindex(range(1, int(df.completed_deliveries.max())+1), fill_value=0)[
        ['Office', 'Residential']].plot.bar(ax=ax, rot=0, width=.72, color=['#397aa7', '#c7813e'])
    ax.set(xlabel='Deliveries completed during one local visit', ylabel='Share of visits within AOI type',
        title='Completed deliveries per Residential and Office visit')
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda value, _: f'{value:.0%}')
    ax.legend(title='AOI type', frameon=False)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True); ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=.2)
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    return counts.round(3)

print(visit_distribution(df))
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def analyze(df, index):
    import matplotlib.dates as mdates
    d = df.copy()
    d['accept_time'] = pd.to_datetime(d.accept_time)
    b = d.groupby('acceptance_burst_id').agg(
        tasks=('delivery_task_id', 'size'), groups=('spatial_group', 'nunique'),
        start=('accept_time', 'min'), end=('accept_time', 'max'))
    b['size'] = np.where(b.tasks <= 4, 'small', 'large')
    within = d.sort_values('accept_time').groupby('acceptance_burst_id').accept_time.diff().dt.total_seconds().dropna()/60
    between = (b.start-b.end.shift()).dt.total_seconds().dropna()/60
    rates = []
    for column in ['acceptance_order_in_burst', 'completion_order_in_burst']:
        pairs = []
        for _, q in d.groupby('acceptance_burst_id'):
            if q.spatial_group.nunique() > 1:
                values = q.sort_values(column).spatial_group.to_numpy()
                pairs.extend(values[1:] == values[:-1])
        rates.append(float(np.mean(pairs)))
    split = b.groupby('size')['groups'].apply(lambda v: float((v > 1).mean()))
    if index == 0:
        evidence = dict(acceptance_bursts=len(b), accepted_tasks=len(d),
            maximum_within_burst_gap_min=round(float(within.max()), 2),
            minimum_between_burst_gap_min=round(float(between.min()), 2))
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(11, 6.5), constrained_layout=True)
        axes[0].scatter(d.accept_time, np.zeros(len(d)), marker='|', s=200, color='#c77c3d')
        for name, row in b.iterrows():
            axes[0].text(row.start+(row.end-row.start)/2, .12, f'{name}\n{row.tasks} tasks', ha='center', fontsize=9)
        axes[0].set(yticks=[], ylim=(-.15, .35), title=f'{len(d)} acceptances in {len(b)} distinct bursts')
        axes[0].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%H:%M'))
        axes[1].hist([within, between], bins=np.linspace(0, max(between)+5, 30), label=['Within burst', 'Between bursts'])
        axes[1].set(xlabel='Acceptance gap (minutes)', ylabel='Number of gaps')
        axes[1].legend(frameon=False)
    elif index == 1:
        evidence = dict(same_group_adjacency_in_acceptance_sequence=round(rates[0], 3),
            same_group_adjacency_in_completion_sequence=round(rates[1], 3))
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5), constrained_layout=True)
        q = d[d.acceptance_burst_id == 'B04']
        palette = dict(zip(sorted(q.spatial_group.unique()), ['#3976a8', '#c77c3d', '#4f846c']))
        for y, column in enumerate(['acceptance_order_in_burst', 'completion_order_in_burst']):
            for group, rows in q.groupby('spatial_group'):
                axes[0].scatter(rows[column], np.full(len(rows), y), color=palette[group], s=75,
                    label=group.split('_')[-1] if y == 0 else None)
        axes[0].set(yticks=[0, 1], yticklabels=['Acceptance', 'Completion'], ylim=(-.5, 1.5),
            xlabel='Task position in sequence', title='B04: destination groups in each sequence')
        axes[0].legend(title='Spatial group', frameon=False)
        axes[1].bar(['Acceptance', 'Completion'], rates, color=['#71808d', '#4f846c'])
        for i, rate in enumerate(rates): axes[1].text(i, rate+.025, f'{rate:.1%}', ha='center')
        axes[1].set(ylim=(0, 1.08), ylabel='Same-group share of adjacent task pairs', title='All multi-group bursts')
    else:
        evidence = dict(small_burst_split_rate=round(split['small'], 3), large_burst_split_rate=round(split['large'], 3))
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5), constrained_layout=True)
        for name, row in b.iterrows():
            ax.scatter(row.tasks, row['groups'], s=90, color='#3976a8' if row['size']=='small' else '#c77c3d')
            ax.annotate(name, (row.tasks, row['groups']), xytext=(5, 7), textcoords='offset points')
        ax.set(xlabel='Tasks accepted in burst (small: ≤4)', ylabel='Distinct destination groups',
            yticks=[1, 2, 3], ylim=(.7, 3.4), title='Burst size and spatial splitting')
    print(evidence)
    return evidence

evidence = analyze(df, 0)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def analyze(df, index):
    import matplotlib.dates as mdates
    d = df.copy()
    d['accept_time'] = pd.to_datetime(d.accept_time)
    b = d.groupby('acceptance_burst_id').agg(
        tasks=('delivery_task_id', 'size'), groups=('spatial_group', 'nunique'),
        start=('accept_time', 'min'), end=('accept_time', 'max'))
    b['size'] = np.where(b.tasks <= 4, 'small', 'large')
    within = d.sort_values('accept_time').groupby('acceptance_burst_id').accept_time.diff().dt.total_seconds().dropna()/60
    between = (b.start-b.end.shift()).dt.total_seconds().dropna()/60
    rates = []
    for column in ['acceptance_order_in_burst', 'completion_order_in_burst']:
        pairs = []
        for _, q in d.groupby('acceptance_burst_id'):
            if q.spatial_group.nunique() > 1:
                values = q.sort_values(column).spatial_group.to_numpy()
                pairs.extend(values[1:] == values[:-1])
        rates.append(float(np.mean(pairs)))
    split = b.groupby('size')['groups'].apply(lambda v: float((v > 1).mean()))
    if index == 0:
        evidence = dict(acceptance_bursts=len(b), accepted_tasks=len(d),
            maximum_within_burst_gap_min=round(float(within.max()), 2),
            minimum_between_burst_gap_min=round(float(between.min()), 2))
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(11, 6.5), constrained_layout=True)
        axes[0].scatter(d.accept_time, np.zeros(len(d)), marker='|', s=200, color='#c77c3d')
        for name, row in b.iterrows():
            axes[0].text(row.start+(row.end-row.start)/2, .12, f'{name}\n{row.tasks} tasks', ha='center', fontsize=9)
        axes[0].set(yticks=[], ylim=(-.15, .35), title=f'{len(d)} acceptances in {len(b)} distinct bursts')
        axes[0].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%H:%M'))
        axes[1].hist([within, between], bins=np.linspace(0, max(between)+5, 30), label=['Within burst', 'Between bursts'])
        axes[1].set(xlabel='Acceptance gap (minutes)', ylabel='Number of gaps')

        axes[1].bar(['Acceptance', 'Completion'], rates, color=['#71808d', '#4f846c'])
        for i, rate in enumerate(rates): axes[1].text(i, rate+.025, f'{rate:.1%}', ha='center')
        axes[1].set(ylim=(0, 1.08), ylabel='Same-group share of adjacent task pairs', title='All multi-group bursts')
    else:

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def priority_plot(df, index):
    d = df.sort_values('completion_order').copy()
    if index == 1:
        q = d[d.pending_count_before_completion >= 9]
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 5.5), constrained_layout=True,
            gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [2.4, 1]})
        x = np.arange(len(d))
        low_positions = x[d.pending_count_before_completion.to_numpy() < 9]
        if len(low_positions):
            axes[0].axvspan(low_positions.min()-.5, low_positions.max()+.5,
                color='#e8edf2', zorder=0)
            axes[0].text(float(low_positions.mean()), 25.5, 'Low backlog (≤8)\nContext only',
                ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9, color='#536170')
        axes[0].scatter(x-.12, d.acceptance_rank_among_pending, color='#c77c3d',
            marker='s', s=65, label='Acceptance rank: 1 = oldest pending task')
        axes[0].scatter(x+.12, d.proximity_rank_among_pending, color='#4f846c',
            s=65, label='Road-distance rank: 1 = nearest destination')
        axes[0].set(xticks=x, xticklabels=d.pending_count_before_completion,
            xlabel='Pending tasks at each successive decision', ylabel='Rank of selected task',
            title='Complete decision sequence: high to low backlog', xlim=(-.6,len(d)-.4),
            ylim=(0, 29), yticks=[1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 24])
        axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=9)
        axes[0].legend(loc='upper left', frameon=False, fontsize=9)
        rates = [(q.proximity_rank_among_pending == 1).mean(),
                 (q.acceptance_rank_among_pending == 1).mean()]
        counts = [int((q.proximity_rank_among_pending == 1).sum()),
                  int((q.acceptance_rank_among_pending == 1).sum())]
        axes[1].bar(['Selected nearest', 'Selected oldest'], rates, color=['#4f846c', '#c77c3d'])
        for i, rate in enumerate(rates):
            axes[1].text(i, rate+.03, f'{counts[i]}/{len(q)} ({rate:.1%})', ha='center')
        axes[1].set(ylim=(0, 1.05), ylabel='Share of decisions', title=f'{len(q)} decisions with ≥9 pending tasks')
        axes[1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v, _: f'{v:.0%}')
        evidence = dict(high_age_median=float(q.acceptance_rank_among_pending.median()),
            high_proximity_median=float(q.proximity_rank_among_pending.median()),
            high_pending_decisions=len(q), nearest_selected_count=counts[0], oldest_selected_count=counts[1])
    else:
        # One remaining task offers no prioritization choice; exclude it.
        d = d[d.pending_count_before_completion > 1].copy()
        d['normalized_age_rank'] = (d.acceptance_rank_among_pending-1)/(d.pending_count_before_completion-1)
        labels = ['Low (2–8)', 'Medium (9–16)', 'High (17–24)']
        d['band'] = pd.cut(d.pending_count_before_completion, [1, 8, 16, 24], labels=labels)
        stats = d.groupby('band', observed=True).normalized_age_rank.agg(['mean', 'count'])
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.7, 5.4), constrained_layout=True)
        axes[0].scatter(d.pending_count_before_completion, d.normalized_age_rank,
            s=65, color='#3976a8', edgecolor='white')
        axes[0].set(xlabel='Pending tasks before completion',
            ylabel='Normalized acceptance rank (0 = oldest, 1 = newest)',
            title='Lower backlog favors earlier-accepted tasks', ylim=(-.03, 1.08))
        axes[1].bar(labels, stats['mean'], color=['#4f846c', '#3976a8', '#c77c3d'])
        for i, row in enumerate(stats.itertuples()):
            axes[1].text(i, row.mean+.025, f'{row.mean:.3f}\nn={row.count}', ha='center')
        axes[1].set(ylabel='Mean normalized acceptance rank (lower = older)',
            title='Backlog groups; single-task case excluded', ylim=(0, 1))
        evidence = dict(mean_normalized_age_rank_by_backlog=stats['mean'].round(3).to_dict(),
            high_minus_medium_mean=round(float(stats.loc[labels[2], 'mean']-stats.loc[labels[1], 'mean']), 3),
            low_pending_age_rank_median=float(d[d.pending_count_before_completion <= 8].acceptance_rank_among_pending.median()),
            excluded_single_task_decisions=1)
    for ax in axes:
        ax.set_axisbelow(True); ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=.2)
        ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    print(evidence)
    return evidence

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def backlog_priority(df,user_df,decisions):
    d=decisions[decisions.selected & decisions.pending_count.ge(2)].copy()
    d['acceptance_rank_fraction']=(d.acceptance_rank-1)/(d.pending_count-1)
    d['proximity_rank_fraction']=(d.proximity_rank-1)/(d.pending_count-1)
    d['backlog']=np.where(d.pending_count>=8,'High (8+)','Low (2–7)')
    means=d.groupby('backlog')[['acceptance_rank_fraction','proximity_rank_fraction']].mean()
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    means.reindex(['Low (2–7)','High (8+)']).plot.bar(ax=axes[0],color=['#527dac','#ca8647'],rot=0)
    axes[0].set(xlabel='Pending workload',ylabel='Mean normalized rank (lower = higher priority)',title='Closer destinations versus earlier acceptances',ylim=(0,1))
    axes[0].legend(['Acceptance time: 0 = earliest accepted','Road distance: 0 = nearest destination'],fontsize=8)
    axes[1].scatter(d.pending_count,d.acceptance_rank_fraction,c='#527dac',alpha=.65,label='Acceptance time: 0 = earliest accepted')
    axes[1].scatter(d.pending_count,d.proximity_rank_fraction,c='#ca8647',marker='x',alpha=.8,label='Road distance: 0 = nearest destination')
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Pending tasks at selection',ylabel='Normalized selected-task rank',title='Time priority and spatial priority at each decision',ylim=(-.05,1.3))
    axes[1].legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper left')
    return {'selected_decisions':len(d),'mean_normalized_ranks':means.to_dict()}

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def deadline_priority(df,user_df,decisions):
    pairs={}
    order=df.set_index('task_id').completion_order
    for _,q in decisions.groupby('decision_id',sort=False):
        for _,urgent in q[q.remaining_window_min.le(20)].iterrows():
            for _,loose in q[(q.remaining_window_min>=40)&(q.candidate_distance_km<urgent.candidate_distance_km)].iterrows():
                key=(urgent.candidate_task_id,loose.candidate_task_id)
                pairs.setdefault(key,{'urgent':key[0],'loose':key[1],
                    'urgent_distance':urgent.candidate_distance_km,'loose_distance':loose.candidate_distance_km,
                    'urgent_remaining':urgent.remaining_window_min,'loose_remaining':loose.remaining_window_min,
                    'urgent_first':bool(order[key[0]]<order[key[1]])})
    pairs=pd.DataFrame(pairs.values());assert len(pairs)
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    rates=pairs.urgent_first.value_counts().reindex([True,False],fill_value=0)
    axes[0].bar(['Urgent task first','Closer loose task first'],rates,color=['#c27548','#6b8da4'])
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Distinct simultaneously pending task pairs',title='Deadline priority can outweigh proximity')
    for i,v in enumerate(rates):axes[0].text(i,v+.2,str(v),ha='center')
    for first,color,label in [(True,'#c27548','Farther urgent task completed first'),
                              (False,'#6b8da4','Closer loose-window task completed first')]:
        subset=pairs[pairs.urgent_first==first]
        axes[1].scatter(subset.loose_distance,subset.urgent_distance,color=color,alpha=.7,
            label=f'{label} ({len(subset)} pairs)')
    lim=max(pairs.urgent_distance.max(),pairs.loose_distance.max())*1.05
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Road distance to closer, loose-window task (km)',
        ylabel='Road distance to farther, urgent task (km)',
        title='Each point = one pending task pair\nColor shows which task was completed first')
    axes[1].legend(loc='lower right',fontsize=7,framealpha=.95)
    axes[1].text(.03,.97,'Urgent: ≤20 min to deadline (including overdue)\nLoose: ≥40 min to deadline\nOnly pairs with the urgent task farther away are included.',
        transform=axes[1].transAxes,ha='left',va='top',fontsize=7,
        bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':.9})
    axes[1].set_ylim(-.15,lim*1.22)
    return {'urgent_threshold_min':20,'loose_threshold_min':40,'distinct_pairs':len(pairs),
            'distinct_urgent_tasks':int(pairs.urgent.nunique()),'urgent_completed_first_share':float(pairs.urgent_first.mean())}

evidence = deadline_priority(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import kendalltau
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def acceptance_location(df,user_df,decisions):
    near=df[df.acceptance_distance_km<=.25].copy()
    away=df[(df.acceptance_distance_km>=.8)&df.last_near_destination_before_acceptance.notna()].copy()
    cohorts=[near,away];labels=['Near at acceptance','Previously near, now away']
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    axes[0].boxplot([q.accept_to_completion_min for q in cohorts],tick_labels=labels,showfliers=False)
    for i,q in enumerate(cohorts,1):
        jitter=np.linspace(-.12,.12,len(q))
        axes[0].scatter(i+jitter,q.accept_to_completion_min,s=25,alpha=.65,color=['#548578','#be8452'][i-1])
        ordered=np.sort(q.accept_to_completion_min)
        axes[1].step(ordered,np.arange(1,len(q)+1)/len(q),where='post',label=f'{labels[i-1]} (n={len(q)})')
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Acceptance → completion (minutes)',title='Tasks accepted locally tend to finish sooner')
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Minutes since acceptance',ylabel='Fraction completed',title='Completion-delay distributions');axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
    return {'near_threshold_km':.25,'away_threshold_km':.8,'near_tasks':len(near),'previously_near_away_tasks':len(away),
            'median_minutes_near':float(near.accept_to_completion_min.median()),
            'median_minutes_away':float(away.accept_to_completion_min.median()),
            'near_faster_pairwise_share':float((near.accept_to_completion_min.to_numpy()[:,None]<away.accept_to_completion_min.to_numpy()).mean())}

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import kendalltau
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def courier_order(df,user_df,decisions):
    rows=[]
    for (courier,day),q in df.groupby(['courier_id','service_date']):
        rows.append({'courier':courier,'day':day,'tasks':len(q),
                     'concordance':float(kendalltau(q.acceptance_order,q.completion_order).statistic)})
    daily=pd.DataFrame(rows);couriers=sorted(daily.courier.unique())
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    axes[0].boxplot([daily[daily.courier.eq(c)].concordance for c in couriers],tick_labels=couriers)
    for i,c in enumerate(couriers,1):
        q=daily[daily.courier.eq(c)];axes[0].scatter(i+np.linspace(-.12,.12,len(q)),q.concordance,s=30)
        axes[1].plot(q.tasks,q.concordance,'o',label=c,alpha=.8)
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Acceptance/pickup Kendall concordance',title='Courier differences persist across matched workdays',ylim=(-1,1))
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Tasks on the workday',ylabel='Ordering concordance',title='Same task volumes and AOI sets within each day');axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
    return {'courier_days':len(daily),'daily_task_range':[int(daily.tasks.min()),int(daily.tasks.max())],
            'mean_concordance_by_courier':daily.groupby('courier').concordance.mean().to_dict()}

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import kendalltau
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def distance_urgency(df,user_df,decisions):
    d=decisions.merge(df[['task_id','acceptance_distance_km']],left_on='candidate_task_id',right_on='task_id',validate='many_to_one')
    d=d[d.pending_count>=4].copy();d['acceptance_location']=np.where(d.acceptance_distance_km>=1.3,'Far (≥1.3 km)','Near (<1.3 km)')
    d['window']=np.where(d.remaining_window_min<=20,'Ending within 20 min','More than 20 min')
    rates=d.groupby(['window','acceptance_location']).selected.mean().unstack()
    rates=rates.reindex(['More than 20 min','Ending within 20 min'])
    tasks=df.copy();tasks['overtaken']=0
    for _,q in tasks.groupby('trajectory_id'):
        for index,row in q.iterrows():
            tasks.loc[index,'overtaken']=int(((q.acceptance_order>row.acceptance_order)&(q.completion_order<row.completion_order)).sum())
    tasks['deferred']=tasks.overtaken>=3
    tasks['location']=np.where(tasks.acceptance_distance_km>=1.3,'Far (≥1.3 km)','Near (<1.3 km)')
    span=(pd.to_datetime(tasks.window_end,format='mixed')-pd.to_datetime(tasks.accept_time,format='mixed')).dt.total_seconds()/60
    tasks['window_span']=np.where(span<=65,'Short (≤65 min)','Long (>65 min)')
    actual=tasks.groupby(['window_span','location']).deferred.mean().unstack()
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.7),constrained_layout=True)
    actual.reindex(['Long (>65 min)','Short (≤65 min)'])[['Near (<1.3 km)','Far (≥1.3 km)']].plot.bar(ax=axes[0],rot=0,color=['#588f86','#bf874f'])
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Share overtaken by ≥3 later-accepted tasks',title='Actual task deferral, by acceptance distance',ylim=(0,.8));axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)
    ratio=rates['Far (≥1.3 km)']/rates['Near (<1.3 km)']
    axes[1].bar(['More than 20 min left','Ending within 20 min'],ratio,color=['#708cab','#c08657'])
    axes[1].axhline(1,color='gray',ls='--',lw=1)
    for i,value in enumerate(ratio):axes[1].text(i,value+.025,f'{value:.2f}',ha='center')
    axes[1].set(ylabel='Far / near selection rate at a decision',title='Far-distance penalty weakens near the deadline',ylim=(0,1.2))
    normal=rates.loc['More than 20 min'];urgent=rates.loc['Ending within 20 min']
    return {'unit':'pending candidate at a decision with at least four tasks; lower selection rate means more deferral',
            'candidate_opportunities':len(d),'selected_rates':rates.to_dict(),
            'actual_task_deferral_rates':actual.to_dict(),'far_to_near_selection_ratio':ratio.to_dict(),
            'near_minus_far_gap_loose':float(normal['Near (<1.3 km)']-normal['Far (≥1.3 km)']),
            'near_minus_far_gap_urgent':float(urgent['Near (<1.3 km)']-urgent['Far (≥1.3 km)'])}

evidence = distance_urgency(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import kendalltau
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def aoi_day_order(df,user_df,decisions):
    rows=[];local=[]
    for (courier,day),q in df.groupby(['courier_id','service_date']):
        mix='A01–A06' if 'A04' in set(q.aoi_id) else 'A01–A03 + A07–A09'
        rows.append({'courier':courier,'day':day,'aoi_set':mix,
                     'tau':float(kendalltau(q.acceptance_order,q.completion_order).statistic)})
        for aoi,r in q.groupby('aoi_id'):
            local.append({'courier':courier,'day':day,'aoi':aoi,
                'group':'Every-day AOIs' if aoi in ['A01','A02','A03'] else 'Rotating AOIs',
                'tau':float(kendalltau(r.acceptance_order,r.completion_order).statistic)})
    daily=pd.DataFrame(rows);local=pd.DataFrame(local)
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    table=daily.groupby(['courier','aoi_set']).tau.mean().unstack()
    table.plot.bar(ax=axes[0],rot=0,color=['#5c88ab','#c68d57'])
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Whole-day ordering concordance',title='Within-courier ordering differs with served AOI sets',ylim=(0,1));axes[0].legend(fontsize=7)
    names=['Every-day AOIs','Rotating AOIs']
    # Measure temporal variability within each courier/AOI first, rather than
    # pooling different couriers and different AOIs into one distribution.
    stability=local.groupby(['courier','aoi','group']).tau.agg(['std','count']).reset_index()
    by_courier=stability.groupby(['courier','group'])['std'].mean().unstack()[names]
    by_courier.plot.bar(ax=axes[1],rot=0,color=['#588f86','#bf874f'],width=.7)
    bar_handles,_=axes[1].get_legend_handles_labels()
    for i,courier in enumerate(by_courier.index):
        for j,name in enumerate(names):
            x=i+(-.175 if j==0 else .175)
            values=stability[(stability.courier==courier)&(stability.group==name)]['std'].to_numpy()
            axes[1].scatter(x+np.linspace(-.065,.065,len(values)),values,
                s=20,facecolors='white',edgecolors='#35495a',zorder=3)
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Courier',ylabel='Across-day SD of within-AOI concordance',
        title='Local ordering stability for each courier\nLower = more stable; each dot = one AOI',ylim=(0,.85))
    axes[1].legend(bar_handles,['Every-day AOIs (8 days each)','Rotating AOIs (4 days each)'],fontsize=7,loc='upper left')
    return {'whole_day_mean_concordance':table.to_dict(),'local_concordance_mean':local.groupby('group').tau.mean().to_dict(),
            'local_concordance_sd':local.groupby('group').tau.std().to_dict(),
            'mean_within_aoi_across_day_sd_by_courier':by_courier.to_dict(),
            'stability_unit':'Compute sample SD across days separately for each courier and AOI, then average AOI SDs within each courier/group.'}

evidence = aoi_day_order(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import kendalltau
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def event_gps_mismatch(df,user_df,decisions):
    d=df.copy();a=np.radians(d[['task_lng','task_lat']].to_numpy());b=np.radians(d[['pickup_gps_lng','pickup_gps_lat']].to_numpy())
    diff=b-a;d['mismatch_m']=6371008.8*2*np.arcsin(np.sqrt(np.sin(diff[:,1]/2)**2+np.cos(a[:,1])*np.cos(b[:,1])*np.sin(diff[:,0]/2)**2))
    d['large']=d.mismatch_m>100;table=d.groupby('aoi_id').agg(tasks=('task_id','size'),large=('large','sum'),days=('service_date','nunique'))
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    rate=table.large/table.tasks
    axes[0].bar(rate.index,rate*100,color=['#bd7055' if x>.3 else '#6c93a3' for x in rate])
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Pickup-event mismatch >100 m (%)',title='A small subset of revisited AOIs contains the large errors',ylim=(0,100))
    for aoi,q in d.groupby('aoi_id'):
        axes[1].scatter(q.task_lng,q.task_lat,s=8,alpha=.35)
    q=d[d.large].head(65)
    for r in q.itertuples():axes[1].plot([r.task_lng,r.pickup_gps_lng],[r.task_lat,r.pickup_gps_lat],color='#bd7055',alpha=.4,lw=.8)
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Longitude',ylabel='Latitude',title='Task location → separate pickup-event GPS observation')
    axes[1].set_aspect(1/np.cos(np.radians(d.task_lat.mean())))
    large=table[table.large>0]
    return {'large_mismatch_threshold_m':100,'large_mismatch_count':int(d.large.sum()),
            'large_mismatches_by_aoi':table.large.astype(int).to_dict(),
            'large_mismatch_rates':rate.to_dict(),'service_days_for_affected_aois':large.days.astype(int).to_dict()}

evidence = event_gps_mismatch(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
supplement=pd.read_csv("courier_days.csv")
aois=pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def workload_effort(df,user_df,supplement,aois):
    d=supplement.copy();small=d[d.task_count<=24].copy()
    small['coverage']=np.where(small.aoi_count>=5,'Broad (5+ AOIs)','Compact (2–3 AOIs)')
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.8),constrained_layout=True)
    p=axes[0].scatter(d.task_count,d.route_length_km,c=d.spatial_spread_km,cmap='viridis',s=55)
    fig.colorbar(p,ax=axes[0],label='Spatial spread: RMS distance from task centroid (km)')
    axes[0].set(xlabel='Tasks per courier-day',ylabel='GPS route length (km)',title='Similar task counts do not imply similar travel')
    p=axes[1].scatter(d.task_count,d.active_duration_hours,c=d.window_overlap_concentration,cmap='plasma',s=55)
    fig.colorbar(p,ax=axes[1],label='Maximum fraction of service windows overlapping')
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Tasks per courier-day',ylabel='Moving + servicing duration (hours)',title='Active time excludes stationary waiting')
    pairs=[]
    for _,day in small.groupby('service_date'):
        for a in day[day.aoi_count<=3].itertuples():
            for b in day[day.aoi_count>=5].itertuples():
                if abs(a.task_count-b.task_count)<=3:

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
supplement=pd.read_csv("courier_days.csv")
aois=pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def busy_aoi_staffing(df,user_df,supplement,aois):
    daily=df.groupby('service_date').size();cut=float(daily.median());high=daily[daily>cut].index
    table=df.groupby(['service_date','aoi_id']).agg(tasks=('pickup_task_id','size'),couriers=('courier_id','nunique')).reset_index()
    table['volume_day']=np.where(table.service_date.isin(high),'High-volume','Quieter')
    busiest=df.groupby('aoi_id').size().nlargest(2).index.tolist();q=table[table.aoi_id.isin(busiest)]
    means=q.groupby(['aoi_id','volume_day']).couriers.mean().unstack().reindex(columns=['Quieter','High-volume'])
    stability={};busy_stability={}
    for regime,dates in [('Quieter',daily[daily<=cut].index),('High-volume',high)]:
        values=[];busy_values=[]
        for aoi in sorted(df.aoi_id.unique()):
            sets=[set(df.loc[df.service_date.eq(date)&df.aoi_id.eq(aoi),'courier_id']) for date in sorted(dates)]
            scores=[len(a&b)/len(a|b) for a,b in zip(sets,sets[1:]) if a|b]
            values.extend(scores)
            if aoi in busiest:busy_values.extend(scores)
        stability[regime]=float(np.mean(values))
        busy_stability[regime]=float(np.mean(busy_values))
    from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch
    dates=sorted(daily.index);couriers=sorted(df.courier_id.unique())
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,8),sharex=True,constrained_layout=True,
        gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1,2]})
    colors=['#c28a58' if date in high else '#64899e' for date in dates]
    axes[0].bar(np.arange(len(dates)),daily.reindex(dates),color=colors,width=.65)
    for i,date in enumerate(dates):axes[0].text(i,daily[date]+3,str(daily[date]),ha='center')
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Total pickup tasks',ylim=(0,float(daily.max())*1.35),
        title='Daily workload and actual staffing at the two busiest AOIs')
    axes[0].legend(handles=[Patch(color='#64899e',label=f'Quieter day (≤{cut:g} tasks)'),
        Patch(color='#c28a58',label=f'High-volume day (>{cut:g} tasks)')],loc='upper left',fontsize=9,frameon=False)
    rows=[(aoi,courier) for aoi in busiest for courier in couriers]
    cells=np.zeros((len(rows),len(dates)))
    for i,(aoi,courier) in enumerate(rows):
        for j,date in enumerate(dates):
            served=((df.aoi_id==aoi)&(df.courier_id==courier)&(df.service_date==date)).any()
            if served:cells[i,j]=2 if date in high else 1
    axes[1].imshow(cells,cmap=ListedColormap(['#f1f3f5','#64899e','#c28a58']),
        vmin=0,vmax=2,aspect='auto',interpolation='nearest')
    for i,j in zip(*np.nonzero(cells)):
        axes[1].text(j,i,'●',ha='center',va='center',color='white',fontsize=11)
    axes[1].set(xticks=np.arange(len(dates)),xticklabels=[date[5:] for date in dates],
        yticks=np.arange(len(rows)),yticklabels=[f'{aoi} / Courier {c.split("_")[-1]}' for aoi,c in rows],
        xlabel='Service date (2026)',title='Colored cell = courier served this AOI that day; pale cell = did not serve')
    axes[1].set_xticks(np.arange(-.5,len(dates),1),minor=True)
    axes[1].set_yticks(np.arange(-.5,len(rows),1),minor=True)
    axes[1].grid(which='minor',color='white',linewidth=2)
    axes[1].tick_params(which='minor',bottom=False,left=False)
    axes[1].axhline(len(couriers)-.5,color='white',linewidth=5)
    axes[0].spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
    return {'daily_task_counts':daily.to_dict(),'high_volume_threshold_tasks':cut,'busiest_aois':busiest,
            'mean_couriers_at_busiest_aois':means.to_dict(),'courier_aoi_assignment_stability':stability,'busy_aoi_assignment_stability':busy_stability}

evidence=busy_aoi_staffing(df,user_df,supplement,aois)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
supplement=pd.read_csv("courier_days.csv")
aois=pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def late_finishing(df,user_df,supplement,aois):
    d=df.copy()
    for col in ['accept_time','pickup_time','time_window_start','time_window_end']:
        d[col]=pd.to_datetime(d[col],format='mixed')
    d['accept_hour']=(d.accept_time-d.accept_time.dt.normalize()).dt.total_seconds()/3600
    d['pickup_hour']=(d.pickup_time-d.pickup_time.dt.normalize()).dt.total_seconds()/3600
    d['window_position']=(d.pickup_time-d.time_window_start)/(d.time_window_end-d.time_window_start)
    d['near_end']=d.window_position.between(.8,1)
    names=['Before 12:00','12:00–17:59','18:00 or later']
    d['acceptance_period']=pd.cut(d.accept_hour,[0,12,18,24],right=False,labels=names)
    stats=d.groupby('acceptance_period',observed=True).agg(tasks=('pickup_task_id','size'),
        near_end_count=('near_end','sum'),near_end_share=('near_end','mean'),median_pickup_hour=('pickup_hour','median'))
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,5),constrained_layout=True)
    for near,color,label in [(False,'#64899e','Pickup before final 20% of window'),
                              (True,'#c28a58','Pickup in final 20% of window')]:
        q=d[d.near_end==near]
        axes[0].scatter(q.accept_hour,q.pickup_hour,color=color,s=22,alpha=.65,label=label)
    axes[0].set(xlabel='Task acceptance time',ylabel='Task pickup time',
        title='Each point = one task',xticks=range(8,23,2),yticks=range(8,25,2))
    for axis in [axes[0].xaxis,axes[0].yaxis]:axis.set_major_formatter(lambda v,_:f'{int(v):02}:00')
    axes[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper left')
    axes[1].bar(names,stats.near_end_share,color=['#64899e','#899cab','#c28a58'])
    for i,row in enumerate(stats.itertuples()):
        axes[1].text(i,row.near_end_share+.025,f'{row.near_end_count}/{row.tasks}\n{row.near_end_share:.1%}',ha='center')
    axes[1].set(ylabel='Share picked up in final 20% of service window',ylim=(0,1.05),
        xlabel='Task acceptance period',title='Later-accepted tasks often finish near the deadline')
    axes[1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v,_:f'{v:.0%}')
    for ax in axes:ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
    late=d[d.accept_hour>=18]
    return {'tasks':len(d),'late_acceptance_threshold_hour':18,'near_window_end_threshold':.8,
        'acceptance_pickup_spearman':float(d.accept_hour.corr(d.pickup_hour,method='spearman')),
        'acceptance_period_statistics':stats.to_dict(),'late_task_count':len(late),
        'late_near_window_end_count':int(late.near_end.sum()),'late_near_window_end_share':float(late.near_end.mean()),
        'late_median_minutes_until_window_end':float((late.time_window_end-late.pickup_time).dt.total_seconds().median()/60)}

evidence=late_finishing(df,user_df,supplement,aois)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

def window_position(df,user_df,supplement,aois):
    d=df.copy();start=pd.to_datetime(d.time_window_start,format='mixed');end=pd.to_datetime(d.time_window_end,format='mixed');pickup=pd.to_datetime(d.pickup_time,format='mixed')
    d['relative_position']=(pickup-start).dt.total_seconds()/(end-start).dt.total_seconds();groups=d.groupby('aoi_id')
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.8),constrained_layout=True)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
supplement=pd.read_csv("aoi_visits.csv")
aois=pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def persistent_subregions(df,user_df,supplement,aois):
    stats={};fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,5.2),constrained_layout=True)
    for ax,(aoi,q) in zip(axes,df.groupby('aoi_id')):
        definition=aois.set_index('aoi_id').loc[aoi];center=np.array([definition.center_lng,definition.center_lat]);scale=np.array([95200,111000])
        daily=q.groupby(['service_date','courier_id'])[['pickup_lng','pickup_lat']].mean().reset_index()
        correct=[];shared=[]
        for day,heldout in q.groupby('service_date'):
            train=q[q.service_date.ne(day)].groupby('courier_id')[['pickup_lng','pickup_lat']].mean()
            x=heldout[['pickup_lng','pickup_lat']].to_numpy()*scale;centroids=train.to_numpy()*scale
            predicted=train.index.to_numpy()[np.linalg.norm(x[:,None]-centroids,axis=2).argmin(axis=1)]
            correct.extend(predicted==heldout.courier_id.to_numpy());sets=[]
            for courier in sorted(q.courier_id.unique()):
                gps=user_df[user_df.service_date.eq(day)&user_df.courier_id.eq(courier)]
                xy=(gps[['lng','lat']].to_numpy()-center)*scale;xy=xy[np.linalg.norm(xy,axis=1)<=definition.radius_m]
                sets.append(set(map(tuple,np.floor(xy/30).astype(int))))
            shared.append(len(sets[0]&sets[1]))
        separation=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(q.groupby('courier_id')[['pickup_lng','pickup_lat']].mean().to_numpy()*scale,axis=0)[0])
        for index,(courier,s) in enumerate(q.groupby('courier_id')):
            ax.scatter(s.pickup_lng,s.pickup_lat,s=18,alpha=.45,label=courier,color=['#548ca3','#c18355'][index])
            dc=daily[daily.courier_id.eq(courier)];ax.plot(dc.pickup_lng,dc.pickup_lat,'x--',lw=.8,color=['#548ca3','#c18355'][index])
        # GPS points near the access corridor expose the shared movement path.
        for courier,gps in user_df[user_df.service_date.eq(user_df.service_date.min())].groupby('courier_id'):
            xy=(gps[['lng','lat']].to_numpy()-center)*scale;mask=np.linalg.norm(xy,axis=1)<=definition.radius_m
            ax.scatter(gps.loc[mask,'lng'],gps.loc[mask,'lat'],s=1,alpha=.12,color='gray')
        visit=supplement[supplement.aoi_id.eq(aoi)&supplement.service_date.eq(supplement.service_date.min())].iloc[0]
        access=user_df[user_df.trajectory_id.eq(visit.trajectory_id)&user_df.route_section.eq(visit.visit_id)].copy()
        access=access[pd.to_datetime(access.gps_time,format='mixed')>=pd.Timestamp(visit.arrival_time)]
        branch=np.flatnonzero((abs(access.lng-definition.branch_lng)<1e-9)&(abs(access.lat-definition.branch_lat)<1e-9))[0]
        access=access.iloc[:branch+1]
        ax.plot(access.lng,access.lat,color='#263c3b',lw=2.4,zorder=4,label='Shared access road')
        ax.set(title=f'AOI {aoi}: pickup subregions and shared access GPS',xlabel='Longitude',ylabel='Latitude');ax.ticklabel_format(useOffset=False)
        ax.set_aspect(1/np.cos(np.radians(center[1])));ax.legend(fontsize=8)
        stats[aoi]={'leave_one_day_out_courier_classification_accuracy':float(np.mean(correct)),
            'courier_pickup_centroid_separation_m':float(separation),'daily_shared_30m_GPS_cells':shared,
            'days':q.service_date.nunique(),'couriers':q.courier_id.nunique()}
    return {'aoi_evidence':stats,'overlap_definition':'Shared 30-metre GPS grid cells inside each constructed AOI; a sampling-based overlap indicator, not an exact road length.'}

evidence=persistent_subregions(df,user_df,supplement,aois)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

def evidence(case, index, df, user_df, legs, visits, extra):
    import json
