import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
legs = pd.read_csv("movement_legs.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("aoi_visits.csv")
extra = {}
extra["aois"] = pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def evidence(case, index, df, user_df, legs, visits, extra):
    import json
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.4, 5.0), constrained_layout=True)
    moving = user_df[user_df.activity_state.eq('travelling')].copy()
    done = df[df.status.eq('completed')].copy()
    value = {}
    if case == 21:
        order = ['primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential']
        moving = moving.merge(legs[['leg_id', 'period']], on='leg_id', validate='many_to_one')
        if index == 1:
            summary = moving.groupby('fclass')[['step_distance_km', 'step_duration_s']].sum().reindex(order)
            summary['movement_speed_kmh'] = summary.step_distance_km/summary.step_duration_s*3600
            summary['completions'] = done.delivery_fclass.value_counts().reindex(order, fill_value=0)
            summary['completions_per_km'] = summary.completions/summary.step_distance_km
            ax.bar(order, summary.movement_speed_kmh, color='#5c8ea7', alpha=.8, label='Movement speed')
            twin = ax.twinx(); twin.plot(order, summary.completions_per_km, 'o-', color='#bd7843')
            ax.set(ylabel='Distance / moving time (km/h)', xlabel='Native OSM fclass')
            twin.set_ylabel('Delivery completions per travelled km', color='#bd7843')
            value = {'road_class_summary': summary.to_dict('index')}
        elif index == 2:
            summary = moving.groupby(['period', 'fclass']).step_distance_km.sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
            summary = summary.div(summary.sum(axis=1), axis=0).reindex(['early', 'late'])
            summary[order].plot.bar(stacked=True, ax=ax, rot=0)
            ax.set(ylabel='Share of all moving distance', xlabel='First / second half of scheduled delivery stops')
            tasks = done.merge(legs[['leg_id', 'period']], left_on='arrival_leg_id', right_on='leg_id')
            value = {'distance_shares': summary.to_dict('index'), 'completion_counts': tasks.period.value_counts().to_dict()}
        else:
            # Smooth spatial AND temporal event kernel, independently measured
            # from task-completion positions/times rather than a generator label.
            frames = []
            for tid, q in moving.groupby('trajectory_id'):
                t = done[done.trajectory_id.eq(tid)]
                x = q[['lng', 'lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2, 111]
                y = t[['delivery_lng', 'delivery_lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2, 111]
                ds = np.linalg.norm(x[:, None]-y[None, :], axis=2)
                a = pd.to_datetime(q.gps_time, format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
                b = pd.to_datetime(t.completion_time, format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
                dt = abs(a[:, None]-b[None, :])/6e10
                q = q.copy(); q['nearby_activity'] = (np.exp(-ds/.30)*np.exp(-dt/30)).sum(axis=1)
                frames.append(q)
            points = pd.concat(frames); values = {}
            for cls in order:
                q = points[points.fclass.eq(cls)]
                bins = pd.qcut(q.nearby_activity, 5, duplicates='drop')
                med = q.groupby(bins, observed=True)[['nearby_activity', 'speed_kmh']].median()
                line = ax.plot(med.nearby_activity, med.speed_kmh, 'o-', label=cls)[0]
                sample = q.sample(min(350, len(q)), random_state=17)
                ax.scatter(sample.nearby_activity, sample.speed_kmh, s=6, alpha=.10, color=line.get_color())
                values[cls] = {'points': len(q), 'spearman': q.nearby_activity.corr(q.speed_kmh, method='spearman'),
                    'low_to_high_activity_speed_drop_kmh': med.speed_kmh.iloc[0]-med.speed_kmh.iloc[-1],
                    'quintile_medians': med.to_dict('list')}
            ax.set(xlabel='Nearby completion intensity (300 m / 30 min exponential kernel)', ylabel='Median moving speed (km/h)'); ax.legend()
            value = {'within_class_evidence': values}
    elif case == 22:
        if index == 1:
            counts = done.groupby(['service_date', 'aoi_id']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
            span = user_df.groupby('trajectory_id').gps_time.agg(['min', 'max'])
            duration = (pd.to_datetime(span['max'], format='mixed')-pd.to_datetime(span['min'], format='mixed')).dt.total_seconds()
            shares = visits.groupby(['trajectory_id', 'aoi_id']).duration_s.sum().unstack(fill_value=0).div(duration, axis=0)
            summary = pd.DataFrame({'mean_deliveries_per_day': counts.mean(), 'mean_work_time_share': shares.mean()})
            summary.plot.bar(y='mean_deliveries_per_day', ax=ax, rot=0, legend=False, color='#608ea4')
            ax.set(ylabel='Completed deliveries per observed day', xlabel='Constructed AOI')
            twin = ax.twinx(); twin.plot(np.arange(len(summary)), summary.mean_work_time_share*100, 'o-', color='#bd7843'); twin.set_ylabel('Mean observed workday time (%)')
            value = {'aoi_summary': summary.to_dict('index'), 'observed_days': counts.shape[0],
                'regular_destination_fclasses': sorted(done[done.regular_aoi.eq('yes')].delivery_fclass.unique().tolist()),
                'fixed_receipt_sites': extra['receipt_events'].groupby('aoi_id')[['lng', 'lat']].nunique().to_dict('index')}
        elif index == 2:
            q = legs[legs.purpose.eq('delivery')]
            plt.close(fig)
            fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.4),constrained_layout=True);ax=axes[0]
            ax.boxplot([q[q.period.eq(p)].route_directness_ratio for p in ['early','late']],
                tick_labels=['Early','Late'])
            ax.set(xlabel='Delivery route phase',ylabel='Travelled / straight-line distance',
                title='Later delivery routes are more direct\nLower ratio = less detour')
            dates=sorted(q.service_date.unique())
            totals=moving.groupby('service_date')[['step_distance_km','step_duration_s']].sum()
            baseline=totals.step_distance_km/totals.step_duration_s*3600
            late=q[q.period.eq('late')].copy()
            late['day_mean_movement_speed_kmh']=late.service_date.map(baseline)
            late['difference_from_day_mean_kmh']=late.mean_speed_kmh-late.day_mean_movement_speed_kmh
            above=late.difference_from_day_mean_kmh.gt(0)
            x=late.service_date.map({day:i for i,day in enumerate(dates)}).to_numpy(dtype=float)
            x+=np.where(late.groupby('service_date').cumcount().eq(0),-.12,.12)
            axes[1].axhline(0,color='#555555',linewidth=1,linestyle='--',label='Same as day mean')
            for mask,color,label in [(above,'#3976a8','Above day mean'),(~above,'#c77c3d','At or below day mean')]:
                axes[1].scatter(x[mask],late.loc[mask,'difference_from_day_mean_kmh'],color=color,s=48,
                    label=f'{label}: {int(mask.sum())}/{len(late)} ({mask.mean():.1%})')
            axes[1].set(xticks=np.arange(len(dates)),xticklabels=[day[5:] for day in dates],
                xlabel='Workday — each point is a delivery leg as time drew to a close',ylabel='Leg speed − day mean movement speed (km/h)',
                title='As time drew to a close:\nMore direct does not guarantee above-average speed')
            axes[1].margins(y=.30)
            axes[1].tick_params(axis='x',rotation=45,labelsize=8)
            axes[1].legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=8,frameon=False)
            axes[1].grid(axis='y',alpha=.15)
            value = {'period_means': q.groupby('period')[['route_directness_ratio', 'mean_speed_kmh']].mean().to_dict('index'),
                'day_mean_definition':'All moving GPS distance / all moving GPS time, including return legs and excluding stops',
                'daily_mean_movement_speed_kmh':baseline.to_dict(),
                'late_delivery_legs':len(late),'late_legs_above_day_mean':int(above.sum()),
                'late_share_above_day_mean':float(above.mean()),
                'late_leg_comparison':late[['leg_id','service_date','mean_speed_kmh','day_mean_movement_speed_kmh','difference_from_day_mean_kmh']].to_dict('records')}
        elif index == 3:
            q = done.copy(); stamp = pd.to_datetime(q.completion_time, format='mixed')
            q['completion_hour'] = stamp.dt.hour+stamp.dt.minute/60+stamp.dt.second/3600
            q['window_hours'] = (pd.to_datetime(q.time_window_end)-pd.to_datetime(q.time_window_start)).dt.total_seconds()/3600
            plt.close(fig)
            fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.5),constrained_layout=True);ax=axes[0]
            groups=[q[q.regular_aoi.eq('no')&q.window_hours.lt(9)],
                    q[q.regular_aoi.eq('no')&q.window_hours.ge(9)],q[q.regular_aoi.eq('yes')&q.window_hours.ge(9)]]
            labels=['Non-regular AOIs\nWindow <9 h','Non-regular AOIs\nWindow ≥9 h','Regular AOIs (A/B)\nWindow ≥9 h']
            colors=['#4f846c','#3976a8','#c77c3d']
            boxes=ax.boxplot([g.completion_hour for g in groups],tick_labels=labels,patch_artist=True)
            for box,color in zip(boxes['boxes'],colors):box.set_facecolor(color);box.set_alpha(.45)
            for i,g in enumerate(groups,1):
                median=g.completion_hour.median();h=int(median);minute=int(round((median-h)*60))
                ax.text(i,17.8,f'n={len(g)}\nMedian {h:02}:{minute:02}',ha='center',fontsize=9)
            ax.set(ylabel='Task completion time (Shanghai)',title='Both non-regular window groups finish earlier',ylim=(7.5,18.5))
            ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v,_:f'{int(v):02}:00')
            ax.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=8)
            for g,label,color,marker in zip(groups,labels,colors,['o','s','^']):
                axes[1].scatter(g.window_hours,g.completion_hour,s=16,alpha=.45,
                    color=color,marker=marker,label=label.replace('\n','; '))
            axes[1].set(xlabel='Service-window duration (hours)',ylabel='Task completion time (Shanghai)',
                title='Wide windows alone do not explain later completion',ylim=(7.5,19.5))
            axes[1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v,_:f'{int(v):02}:00')
            axes[1].legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=8,frameon=False)
            axes[1].grid(alpha=.15)
            nvisits = visits.groupby(['service_date', 'aoi_id']).size()
            value = {'group_medians': q.groupby('regular_aoi')[['completion_hour', 'window_hours']].median().to_dict('index'),
                'regular_aoi_visits_per_day': nvisits.unstack(fill_value=0)[['A', 'B']].to_dict('list'),
                'irregular_by_window_median_hour': q[q.regular_aoi.eq('no')].assign(window_group=lambda d: np.where(d.window_hours < 9, 'Narrower (<9h)', 'Wide (9h+)')).groupby('window_group').completion_hour.median().to_dict(),
                'plotted_groups':{label.replace('\n','; '):{'tasks':len(g),'median_completion_hour':float(g.completion_hour.median()),
                    'window_hours_min':float(g.window_hours.min()),'window_hours_max':float(g.window_hours.max())}
                    for label,g in zip(labels,groups)},
                'uncompleted_tasks_excluded':int(df.status.ne('completed').sum())}
        else:
            irregular = df[df.regular_aoi.eq('no')]
            summary = irregular.groupby(['service_date', 'status']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
            summary.plot.bar(stacked=True, ax=ax, rot=50)
            ax.set(ylabel='Available irregular-AOI tasks', xlabel='Workday')
            pending = irregular[irregular.status.eq('pending')]; dates = pending.service_date.unique().tolist()
            min_dist = {}
            for day in dates:
                gps = user_df[user_df.service_date.eq(day)]
                destinations = pending[pending.service_date.eq(day)][['aoi_id', 'delivery_lng', 'delivery_lat']].drop_duplicates()
                for r in destinations.itertuples():
                    ds = np.linalg.norm((gps[['lng', 'lat']].to_numpy()-[r.delivery_lng, r.delivery_lat])*[95200, 111000], axis=1)
                    min_dist[r.aoi_id] = float(ds.min())
            value = {'pending_dates': dates, 'pending_tasks': len(pending), 'minimum_GPS_distance_to_unvisited_AOI_m': min_dist,
                'anomaly_day_irregular_visit_count': int(len(visits[visits.service_date.isin(dates)&~visits.aoi_id.isin(['A', 'B'])]))}
    elif case == 23:
        q = legs[legs.purpose.eq('delivery')].copy()
        # Initial departure is not between two completed task locations.
        q = q[q.groupby('trajectory_id').cumcount().gt(0)]
        if index == 1:
            q = q[q.period.ne('exception')&q.separation_km.between(.8, 1.3)]
            q['oneway_group'] = np.where(q.oneway_share >= .55, 'High (55%+)', np.where(q.oneway_share <= .25, 'Low (0–25%)', 'Middle'))
            q = q[q.oneway_group.ne('Middle')]
            summary = q.groupby('oneway_group')[['separation_km', 'route_directness_ratio', 'mean_speed_kmh']].mean()
            high, low = summary.loc['High (55%+)'], summary.loc['Low (0–25%)']
            relative = pd.Series({
                'Route directness': (high.route_directness_ratio/low.route_directness_ratio-1)*100,
                'Average speed': (high.mean_speed_kmh/low.mean_speed_kmh-1)*100})
            plt.close(fig)
            fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5.5), constrained_layout=True); ax = axes[0]
            for name, s in q.groupby('oneway_group'):
                ax.scatter(s.separation_km, s.route_directness_ratio, label=name, alpha=.6)
            ax.set(xlabel='Task endpoint separation (km)', ylabel='Travelled / straight-line distance',
                title='Matched endpoint separations (0.8–1.3 km)'); ax.legend()
            bars = axes[1].bar(relative.index, relative.values, color=['#3976a8', '#c77c3d'], alpha=.82)
            axes[1].axhline(0, color='#666666', linewidth=1)
            axes[1].bar_label(bars, labels=[
                f'+{relative.iloc[0]:.1f}%\n{low.route_directness_ratio:.2f} → {high.route_directness_ratio:.2f}',
                f'+{relative.iloc[1]:.1f}%\n{low.mean_speed_kmh:.1f} → {high.mean_speed_kmh:.1f} km/h'],
                padding=5, fontsize=10)
            axes[1].set(ylabel='High one-way group relative to low group (%)',
                title='Average speed differs less than route directness',
                ylim=(0, max(relative)*1.42))
            axes[1].grid(axis='y', alpha=.15)
            value = {'matched_separation_range_km': [.8, 1.3], 'group_means': summary.to_dict('index'),
                'high_vs_low_relative_difference_percent': relative.to_dict(),
                'within_period_group_means': q.groupby(['period', 'oneway_group'])[['route_directness_ratio', 'mean_speed_kmh']].mean().reset_index().to_dict('records')}
        elif index == 2:
            means = q[q.period.ne('exception')].groupby('period')[['mean_speed_kmh', 'route_directness_ratio']].mean().reindex(['early', 'midday', 'late'])
            stamp=pd.to_datetime(q.departure_time,format='mixed')
            q['departure_hour']=(stamp-stamp.dt.normalize()).dt.total_seconds()/3600
            centers=np.arange(np.floor(q.departure_hour.min()*6)/6,np.ceil(q.departure_hour.max()*6)/6+1/12,1/6)
            windows=[]
            for center in centers:
                subset=q[q.departure_hour.between(center-.5,center+.5)]
                windows.append({'center_hour':float(center),'legs':len(subset),
                    **{column:float(subset[column].median()) if len(subset)>=8 else None
                       for column in ['mean_speed_kmh','route_directness_ratio']}})
            trend=pd.DataFrame(windows)
            plt.close(fig)
            fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(9.5,7),sharex=True,constrained_layout=True)
            fig.suptitle('Speed and detour over actual departure time',fontsize=15)
            for axis,column,color,title in [

            axes[0].set_ylabel('Mean movement speed (km/h)')

            ticks=np.arange(np.floor(q.departure_hour.min()),np.ceil(q.departure_hour.max())+1)
            axes[1].set(xticks=ticks,xticklabels=[f'{int(h):02}:00' for h in ticks],

            value = {'period_means': means.to_dict('index'),

        elif index == 3:

            p['transitions_per_km'] = p.transitions/p.distance
            cut = p.transitions_per_km.median(); p['transition_group'] = np.where(p.transitions_per_km > cut, 'Frequent', 'Less frequent')
            pearson=p.transitions_per_km.corr(p.detour_sd)

            ax.scatter(p.transitions_per_km,p.detour_sd,color='#3976a8',s=43,alpha=.72,

            ax.legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=8,frameon=False);ax.grid(alpha=.15)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
legs = pd.read_csv("movement_legs.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("aoi_visits.csv")
extra = {}
extra["crossings"] = pd.read_csv("crossings.csv")
extra["aois"] = pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def evidence(case, index, df, user_df, legs, visits, extra):
    import json
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.4, 5.0), constrained_layout=True)
    moving = user_df[user_df.activity_state.eq('travelling')].copy()
    done = df[df.status.eq('completed')].copy()
    value = {}
    if case == 21:
        order = ['primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential']
        moving = moving.merge(legs[['leg_id', 'period']], on='leg_id', validate='many_to_one')
        if index == 1:
            summary = moving.groupby('fclass')[['step_distance_km', 'step_duration_s']].sum().reindex(order)
            summary['movement_speed_kmh'] = summary.step_distance_km/summary.step_duration_s*3600
            summary['completions'] = done.delivery_fclass.value_counts().reindex(order, fill_value=0)
            summary['completions_per_km'] = summary.completions/summary.step_distance_km
            ax.bar(order, summary.movement_speed_kmh, color='#5c8ea7', alpha=.8, label='Movement speed')
            twin = ax.twinx(); twin.plot(order, summary.completions_per_km, 'o-', color='#bd7843')
            ax.set(ylabel='Distance / moving time (km/h)', xlabel='Native OSM fclass')
            twin.set_ylabel('Delivery completions per travelled km', color='#bd7843')
            value = {'road_class_summary': summary.to_dict('index')}
        elif index == 2:
            summary = moving.groupby(['period', 'fclass']).step_distance_km.sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
            summary = summary.div(summary.sum(axis=1), axis=0).reindex(['early', 'late'])
            summary[order].plot.bar(stacked=True, ax=ax, rot=0)
            ax.set(ylabel='Share of all moving distance', xlabel='First / second half of scheduled delivery stops')
            tasks = done.merge(legs[['leg_id', 'period']], left_on='arrival_leg_id', right_on='leg_id')
            value = {'distance_shares': summary.to_dict('index'), 'completion_counts': tasks.period.value_counts().to_dict()}
        else:
            # Smooth spatial AND temporal event kernel, independently measured
            # from task-completion positions/times rather than a generator label.
            frames = []
            for tid, q in moving.groupby('trajectory_id'):
                t = done[done.trajectory_id.eq(tid)]
                x = q[['lng', 'lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2, 111]
                y = t[['delivery_lng', 'delivery_lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2, 111]
                ds = np.linalg.norm(x[:, None]-y[None, :], axis=2)
                a = pd.to_datetime(q.gps_time, format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
                b = pd.to_datetime(t.completion_time, format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
                dt = abs(a[:, None]-b[None, :])/6e10
                q = q.copy(); q['nearby_activity'] = (np.exp(-ds/.30)*np.exp(-dt/30)).sum(axis=1)
                frames.append(q)
            points = pd.concat(frames); values = {}
            for cls in order:
                q = points[points.fclass.eq(cls)]
                bins = pd.qcut(q.nearby_activity, 5, duplicates='drop')
                med = q.groupby(bins, observed=True)[['nearby_activity', 'speed_kmh']].median()
                line = ax.plot(med.nearby_activity, med.speed_kmh, 'o-', label=cls)[0]
                sample = q.sample(min(350, len(q)), random_state=17)
                ax.scatter(sample.nearby_activity, sample.speed_kmh, s=6, alpha=.10, color=line.get_color())
                values[cls] = {'points': len(q), 'spearman': q.nearby_activity.corr(q.speed_kmh, method='spearman'),
                    'low_to_high_activity_speed_drop_kmh': med.speed_kmh.iloc[0]-med.speed_kmh.iloc[-1],
                    'quintile_medians': med.to_dict('list')}
            ax.set(xlabel='Nearby completion intensity (300 m / 30 min exponential kernel)', ylabel='Median moving speed (km/h)'); ax.legend()
            value = {'within_class_evidence': values}
    elif case == 22:
        if index == 1:
            counts = done.groupby(['service_date', 'aoi_id']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
            span = user_df.groupby('trajectory_id').gps_time.agg(['min', 'max'])
            duration = (pd.to_datetime(span['max'], format='mixed')-pd.to_datetime(span['min'], format='mixed')).dt.total_seconds()
            shares = visits.groupby(['trajectory_id', 'aoi_id']).duration_s.sum().unstack(fill_value=0).div(duration, axis=0)
            summary = pd.DataFrame({'mean_deliveries_per_day': counts.mean(), 'mean_work_time_share': shares.mean()})
            summary.plot.bar(y='mean_deliveries_per_day', ax=ax, rot=0, legend=False, color='#608ea4')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
legs = pd.read_csv("movement_legs.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("aoi_visits.csv")
extra = {}
extra["crossings"] = pd.read_csv("crossings.csv")
extra["aois"] = pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def evidence(case, index, df, user_df, legs, visits, extra):
    import json
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.4, 5.0), constrained_layout=True)
    moving = user_df[user_df.activity_state.eq('travelling')].copy()
    done = df[df.status.eq('completed')].copy()
    value = {}
    if case == 21:
        order = ['primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential']
        moving = moving.merge(legs[['leg_id', 'period']], on='leg_id', validate='many_to_one')
        if index == 1:
            summary = moving.groupby('fclass')[['step_distance_km', 'step_duration_s']].sum().reindex(order)
            summary['movement_speed_kmh'] = summary.step_distance_km/summary.step_duration_s*3600
            summary['completions'] = done.delivery_fclass.value_counts().reindex(order, fill_value=0)

dependency_annotation.code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
legs = pd.read_csv("movement_legs.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("aoi_visits.csv")
extra = {}
extra["crossings"] = pd.read_csv("crossings.csv")
extra["aois"] = pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def evidence(case, index, df, user_df, legs, visits, extra):
    import json
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.4, 5.0), constrained_layout=True)
    moving = user_df[user_df.activity_state.eq('travelling')].copy()
    done = df[df.status.eq('completed')].copy()
    value = {}
    if case == 21:
        order = ['primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential']
        moving = moving.merge(legs[['leg_id', 'period']], on='leg_id', validate='many_to_one')
        if index == 1:
            summary = moving.groupby('fclass')[['step_distance_km', 'step_duration_s']].sum().reindex(order)
            summary['movement_speed_kmh'] = summary.step_distance_km/summary.step_duration_s*3600
            summary['completions'] = done.delivery_fclass.value_counts().reindex(order, fill_value=0)
            summary['completions_per_km'] = summary.completions/summary.step_distance_km
            ax.bar(order, summary.movement_speed_kmh, color='#5c8ea7', alpha=.8, label='Movement speed')
            twin = ax.twinx(); twin.plot(order, summary.completions_per_km, 'o-', color='#bd7843')
            ax.set(ylabel='Distance / moving time (km/h)', xlabel='Native OSM fclass')
            twin.set_ylabel('Delivery completions per travelled km', color='#bd7843')
            value = {'road_class_summary': summary.to_dict('index')}
        elif index == 2:
            summary = moving.groupby(['period', 'fclass']).step_distance_km.sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
            summary = summary.div(summary.sum(axis=1), axis=0).reindex(['early', 'late'])
            summary[order].plot.bar(stacked=True, ax=ax, rot=0)
            ax.set(ylabel='Share of all moving distance', xlabel='First / second half of scheduled delivery stops')
            tasks = done.merge(legs[['leg_id', 'period']], left_on='arrival_leg_id', right_on='leg_id')
            value = {'distance_shares': summary.to_dict('index'), 'completion_counts': tasks.period.value_counts().to_dict()}
        else:
            # Smooth spatial AND temporal event kernel, independently measured
            # from task-completion positions/times rather than a generator label.
            frames = []
            for tid, q in moving.groupby('trajectory_id'):
                t = done[done.trajectory_id.eq(tid)]
                x = q[['lng', 'lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2, 111]
                y = t[['delivery_lng', 'delivery_lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2, 111]
                ds = np.linalg.norm(x[:, None]-y[None, :], axis=2)
                a = pd.to_datetime(q.gps_time, format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
                b = pd.to_datetime(t.completion_time, format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
                dt = abs(a[:, None]-b[None, :])/6e10
                q = q.copy(); q['nearby_activity'] = (np.exp(-ds/.30)*np.exp(-dt/30)).sum(axis=1)
                frames.append(q)
            points = pd.concat(frames); values = {}
            for cls in order:
                q = points[points.fclass.eq(cls)]
                bins = pd.qcut(q.nearby_activity, 5, duplicates='drop')
                med = q.groupby(bins, observed=True)[['nearby_activity', 'speed_kmh']].median()
                line = ax.plot(med.nearby_activity, med.speed_kmh, 'o-', label=cls)[0]
                sample = q.sample(min(350, len(q)), random_state=17)
                ax.scatter(sample.nearby_activity, sample.speed_kmh, s=6, alpha=.10, color=line.get_color())
                values[cls] = {'points': len(q), 'spearman': q.nearby_activity.corr(q.speed_kmh, method='spearman'),
                    'low_to_high_activity_speed_drop_kmh': med.speed_kmh.iloc[0]-med.speed_kmh.iloc[-1],
                    'quintile_medians': med.to_dict('list')}
            ax.set(xlabel='Nearby completion intensity (300 m / 30 min exponential kernel)', ylabel='Median moving speed (km/h)'); ax.legend()
            value = {'within_class_evidence': values}
    elif case == 22:
        if index == 1:
            counts = done.groupby(['service_date', 'aoi_id']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
            span = user_df.groupby('trajectory_id').gps_time.agg(['min', 'max'])
            duration = (pd.to_datetime(span['max'], format='mixed')-pd.to_datetime(span['min'], format='mixed')).dt.total_seconds()
            shares = visits.groupby(['trajectory_id', 'aoi_id']).duration_s.sum().unstack(fill_value=0).div(duration, axis=0)
            summary = pd.DataFrame({'mean_deliveries_per_day': counts.mean(), 'mean_work_time_share': shares.mean()})
            summary.plot.bar(y='mean_deliveries_per_day', ax=ax, rot=0, legend=False, color='#608ea4')
            ax.set(ylabel='Completed deliveries per observed day', xlabel='Constructed AOI')
            twin = ax.twinx(); twin.plot(np.arange(len(summary)), summary.mean_work_time_share*100, 'o-', color='#bd7843'); twin.set_ylabel('Mean observed workday time (%)')
            value = {'aoi_summary': summary.to_dict('index'), 'observed_days': counts.shape[0],
                'regular_destination_fclasses': sorted(done[done.regular_aoi.eq('yes')].delivery_fclass.unique().tolist()),
                'fixed_receipt_sites': extra['receipt_events'].groupby('aoi_id')[['lng', 'lat']].nunique().to_dict('index')}
        elif index == 2:
            q = legs[legs.purpose.eq('delivery')]
            plt.close(fig)
            fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.4),constrained_layout=True);ax=axes[0]
            ax.boxplot([q[q.period.eq(p)].route_directness_ratio for p in ['early','late']],
                tick_labels=['Early','Late'])
            ax.set(xlabel='Delivery route phase',ylabel='Travelled / straight-line distance',
                title='Later delivery routes are more direct\nLower ratio = less detour')
            dates=sorted(q.service_date.unique())
            totals=moving.groupby('service_date')[['step_distance_km','step_duration_s']].sum()
            baseline=totals.step_distance_km/totals.step_duration_s*3600
            late=q[q.period.eq('late')].copy()
            late['day_mean_movement_speed_kmh']=late.service_date.map(baseline)
            late['difference_from_day_mean_kmh']=late.mean_speed_kmh-late.day_mean_movement_speed_kmh
            above=late.difference_from_day_mean_kmh.gt(0)
            x=late.service_date.map({day:i for i,day in enumerate(dates)}).to_numpy(dtype=float)
            x+=np.where(late.groupby('service_date').cumcount().eq(0),-.12,.12)
            axes[1].axhline(0,color='#555555',linewidth=1,linestyle='--',label='Same as day mean')
            for mask,color,label in [(above,'#3976a8','Above day mean'),(~above,'#c77c3d','At or below day mean')]:
                axes[1].scatter(x[mask],late.loc[mask,'difference_from_day_mean_kmh'],color=color,s=48,
                    label=f'{label}: {int(mask.sum())}/{len(late)} ({mask.mean():.1%})')
            axes[1].set(xticks=np.arange(len(dates)),xticklabels=[day[5:] for day in dates],
                xlabel='Workday — each point is a delivery leg as time drew to a close',ylabel='Leg speed − day mean movement speed (km/h)',
                title='As time drew to a close:\nMore direct does not guarantee above-average speed')
            axes[1].margins(y=.30)
            axes[1].tick_params(axis='x',rotation=45,labelsize=8)
            axes[1].legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=8,frameon=False)
            axes[1].grid(axis='y',alpha=.15)
            value = {'period_means': q.groupby('period')[['route_directness_ratio', 'mean_speed_kmh']].mean().to_dict('index'),
                'day_mean_definition':'All moving GPS distance / all moving GPS time, including return legs and excluding stops',
                'daily_mean_movement_speed_kmh':baseline.to_dict(),
                'late_delivery_legs':len(late),'late_legs_above_day_mean':int(above.sum()),
                'late_share_above_day_mean':float(above.mean()),
                'late_leg_comparison':late[['leg_id','service_date','mean_speed_kmh','day_mean_movement_speed_kmh','difference_from_day_mean_kmh']].to_dict('records')}
        elif index == 3:
            q = done.copy(); stamp = pd.to_datetime(q.completion_time, format='mixed')
            q['completion_hour'] = stamp.dt.hour+stamp.dt.minute/60+stamp.dt.second/3600
            q['window_hours'] = (pd.to_datetime(q.time_window_end)-pd.to_datetime(q.time_window_start)).dt.total_seconds()/3600
            plt.close(fig)
            fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.5),constrained_layout=True);ax=axes[0]
            groups=[q[q.regular_aoi.eq('no')&q.window_hours.lt(9)],
                    q[q.regular_aoi.eq('no')&q.window_hours.ge(9)],q[q.regular_aoi.eq('yes')&q.window_hours.ge(9)]]
            labels=['Non-regular AOIs\nWindow <9 h','Non-regular AOIs\nWindow ≥9 h','Regular AOIs (A/B)\nWindow ≥9 h']
            colors=['#4f846c','#3976a8','#c77c3d']
            boxes=ax.boxplot([g.completion_hour for g in groups],tick_labels=labels,patch_artist=True)
            for box,color in zip(boxes['boxes'],colors):box.set_facecolor(color);box.set_alpha(.45)
            for i,g in enumerate(groups,1):
                median=g.completion_hour.median();h=int(median);minute=int(round((median-h)*60))
                ax.text(i,17.8,f'n={len(g)}\nMedian {h:02}:{minute:02}',ha='center',fontsize=9)
            ax.set(ylabel='Task completion time (Shanghai)',title='Both non-regular window groups finish earlier',ylim=(7.5,18.5))
            ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v,_:f'{int(v):02}:00')
            ax.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=8)
            for g,label,color,marker in zip(groups,labels,colors,['o','s','^']):
                axes[1].scatter(g.window_hours,g.completion_hour,s=16,alpha=.45,
                    color=color,marker=marker,label=label.replace('\n','; '))
            axes[1].set(xlabel='Service-window duration (hours)',ylabel='Task completion time (Shanghai)',
                title='Wide windows alone do not explain later completion',ylim=(7.5,19.5))
            axes[1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v,_:f'{int(v):02}:00')
            axes[1].legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=8,frameon=False)
            axes[1].grid(alpha=.15)
            nvisits = visits.groupby(['service_date', 'aoi_id']).size()
            value = {'group_medians': q.groupby('regular_aoi')[['completion_hour', 'window_hours']].median().to_dict('index'),
                'regular_aoi_visits_per_day': nvisits.unstack(fill_value=0)[['A', 'B']].to_dict('list'),
                'irregular_by_window_median_hour': q[q.regular_aoi.eq('no')].assign(window_group=lambda d: np.where(d.window_hours < 9, 'Narrower (<9h)', 'Wide (9h+)')).groupby('window_group').completion_hour.median().to_dict(),
                'plotted_groups':{label.replace('\n','; '):{'tasks':len(g),'median_completion_hour':float(g.completion_hour.median()),
                    'window_hours_min':float(g.window_hours.min()),'window_hours_max':float(g.window_hours.max())}
                    for label,g in zip(labels,groups)},
                'uncompleted_tasks_excluded':int(df.status.ne('completed').sum())}
        else:
            irregular = df[df.regular_aoi.eq('no')]
            summary = irregular.groupby(['service_date', 'status']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
            summary.plot.bar(stacked=True, ax=ax, rot=50)
            ax.set(ylabel='Available irregular-AOI tasks', xlabel='Workday')
            pending = irregular[irregular.status.eq('pending')]; dates = pending.service_date.unique().tolist()
            min_dist = {}
            for day in dates:
                gps = user_df[user_df.service_date.eq(day)]
                destinations = pending[pending.service_date.eq(day)][['aoi_id', 'delivery_lng', 'delivery_lat']].drop_duplicates()
                for r in destinations.itertuples():
                    ds = np.linalg.norm((gps[['lng', 'lat']].to_numpy()-[r.delivery_lng, r.delivery_lat])*[95200, 111000], axis=1)
                    min_dist[r.aoi_id] = float(ds.min())
            value = {'pending_dates': dates, 'pending_tasks': len(pending), 'minimum_GPS_distance_to_unvisited_AOI_m': min_dist,
                'anomaly_day_irregular_visit_count': int(len(visits[visits.service_date.isin(dates)&~visits.aoi_id.isin(['A', 'B'])]))}
    elif case == 23:
        q = legs[legs.purpose.eq('delivery')].copy()
        # Initial departure is not between two completed task locations.
        q = q[q.groupby('trajectory_id').cumcount().gt(0)]
        if index == 1:
            q = q[q.period.ne('exception')&q.separation_km.between(.7, 1.4)]
            q['oneway_group'] = np.where(q.oneway_share >= .55, 'High (55%+)', np.where(q.oneway_share <= .25, 'Low (0–25%)', 'Middle'))
            q = q[q.oneway_group.ne('Middle')]
            for name, s in q.groupby('oneway_group'): ax.scatter(s.separation_km, s.route_directness_ratio, label=name, alpha=.6)
            ax.set(xlabel='Task endpoint separation (km)', ylabel='Travelled / straight-line distance'); ax.legend()
            value = {'matched_separation_range_km': [.7, 1.4], 'group_means': q.groupby('oneway_group')[['separation_km', 'route_directness_ratio', 'mean_speed_kmh']].mean().to_dict('index'),
                'within_period_group_means': q.groupby(['period', 'oneway_group'])[['route_directness_ratio', 'mean_speed_kmh']].mean().reset_index().to_dict('records')}
        elif index == 2:
            means = q[q.period.ne('exception')].groupby('period')[['mean_speed_kmh', 'route_directness_ratio']].mean().reindex(['early', 'midday', 'late'])
            stamp=pd.to_datetime(q.departure_time,format='mixed')
            q['departure_hour']=(stamp-stamp.dt.normalize()).dt.total_seconds()/3600
            centers=np.arange(np.floor(q.departure_hour.min()*6)/6,np.ceil(q.departure_hour.max()*6)/6+1/12,1/6)
            windows=[]
            for center in centers:
                subset=q[q.departure_hour.between(center-.5,center+.5)]
                windows.append({'center_hour':float(center),'legs':len(subset),
                    **{column:float(subset[column].median()) if len(subset)>=8 else None
                       for column in ['mean_speed_kmh','route_directness_ratio']}})
            trend=pd.DataFrame(windows)
            plt.close(fig)
            fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(9.5,7),sharex=True,constrained_layout=True)
            fig.suptitle('Speed and detour over actual departure time',fontsize=15)
            for axis,column,color,title in [
                (axes[0],'mean_speed_kmh','#3976a8','Movement speed of each task-to-task leg'),
                (axes[1],'route_directness_ratio','#c77c3d','Route detour of the same legs at the same times')]:
                normal=q[q.period.ne('exception')];exception=q[q.period.eq('exception')]
                axis.scatter(normal.departure_hour,normal[column],s=22,color=color,alpha=.45,
                    label=f'Task-to-task legs ({len(normal)}; 14 days)')
                axis.scatter(exception.departure_hour,exception[column],s=110,color='#8c405f',marker='*',
                    label='Exceptional leg (insight 4)',zorder=4)
                axis.plot(trend.center_hour,trend[column],color=color,linewidth=2.5,
                    label='60-min rolling median (≥8 legs)')
                axis.set_title(title,fontsize=11)
                axis.grid(axis='y',alpha=.15)
                axis.margins(x=.03,y=.30)
                axis.legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=8,frameon=False)
            axes[0].set_ylabel('Mean movement speed (km/h)')
            axes[1].set_ylabel('Travelled / straight-line distance\nHigher = more detour')
            ticks=np.arange(np.floor(q.departure_hour.min()),np.ceil(q.departure_hour.max())+1)
            axes[1].set(xticks=ticks,xticklabels=[f'{int(h):02}:00' for h in ticks],
                xlabel='Actual leg departure time (Shanghai local time; days overlaid)')
            value = {'period_means': means.to_dict('index'),
                'period_means_note':'Legacy phase aggregates retained for compatibility; not used to draw this chart.',
                'plotted_task_to_task_legs':len(q),'exception_legs_included':int(q.period.eq('exception').sum()),
                'rolling_window_minutes':60,'minimum_legs_per_window':8,
                'clock_time_rolling_medians':[window for window in windows if window['legs']>=8],
                'omitted_window_centers_hour':[window['center_hour'] for window in windows if window['legs']<8]}
        elif index == 3:
            p = q[q.period.ne('exception')].groupby(['service_date', 'period']).agg(detour_sd=('route_directness_ratio', 'std'), speed_sd=('mean_speed_kmh', 'std'), transitions=('fclass_transitions', 'sum'), distance=('distance_km', 'sum'))
            p['transitions_per_km'] = p.transitions/p.distance
            ax.scatter(p.transitions_per_km, p.detour_sd, c=p.speed_sd, cmap='viridis', s=50)
            fig.colorbar(ax.collections[0], ax=ax, label='Across-leg speed SD (km/h)')
            ax.set(xlabel='Native fclass transitions per travelled km', ylabel='Within-period route-ratio SD')
            cut = p.transitions_per_km.median(); p['transition_group'] = np.where(p.transitions_per_km > cut, 'Frequent', 'Less frequent')
            value = {'correlation_transition_frequency_detour_sd': p.transitions_per_km.corr(p.detour_sd),
                'group_means': p.groupby('transition_group')[['detour_sd', 'speed_sd', 'transitions_per_km']].mean().to_dict('index'), 'period_count': len(p)}
        else:
            normal = q[q.period.ne('exception')]; exception = q[q.period.eq('exception')]
            ax.scatter(normal.oneway_share*100, normal.route_directness_ratio, alpha=.4, label='Other task legs')
            ax.scatter(exception.oneway_share*100, exception.route_directness_ratio, marker='*', s=220, color='#c66643', label='Exceptional period')
            ax.set(xlabel='One-way-road distance (%)', ylabel='Travelled / straight-line distance'); ax.legend()
            value = {'exception': exception[['leg_id', 'route_directness_ratio', 'oneway_share', 'mean_speed_kmh', 'distance_km', 'separation_km']].to_dict('records'),
                'normal_speed_10_90_percentiles': normal.mean_speed_kmh.quantile([.1, .9]).tolist(),
                'schema_oneway_unit_assumption': '2.01 interpreted provisionally as percent, pending user confirmation'}
    elif case == 24:
        if index == 1:
            q = legs[legs.purpose.str.startswith('road_condition')]
            q.boxplot(column='speed_std_kmh', by='purpose', ax=ax); fig.suptitle('')
            ax.set(xlabel='Road condition', ylabel='Short-term GPS speed SD (km/h)', title='Stable residential travel versus alternating road classes')
            value = {'condition_means': q.groupby('purpose')[['speed_std_kmh', 'residential_share', 'tertiary_share', 'fclass_transitions']].mean().to_dict('index')}
        else:
            q = extra['crossings'].merge(legs, left_on='crossing_leg_id', right_on='leg_id', validate='one_to_one')
            low = moving[moving.speed_kmh < 12].groupby('leg_id').step_duration_s.sum()
            q['low_speed_seconds'] = q.leg_id.map(low).fillna(0)
            approach = legs.set_index('leg_id').mean_speed_kmh
            q['speed_drop_kmh'] = q.approach_leg_id.map(approach)-q.mean_speed_kmh
            if index == 2:
                # Fluctuation is within-crossing GPS speed SD, not variation

                recomputed=moving.groupby('leg_id').speed_kmh.agg(lambda s:float(np.std(s.to_numpy(),ddof=0)))

            ax.set(ylabel='Share of all moving distance', xlabel='First / second half of scheduled delivery stops')

        else:
            # Smooth spatial AND temporal event kernel, independently measured

                b = pd.to_datetime(t.completion_time, format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
                dt = abs(a[:, None]-b[None, :])/6e10
                q = q.copy(); q['nearby_activity'] = (np.exp(-ds/.30)*np.exp(-dt/30)).sum(axis=1)
                frames.append(q)
            points = pd.concat(frames); values = {}
            for cls in order:

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
legs = pd.read_csv("movement_legs.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("aoi_visits.csv")
extra = {}
extra["regions"] = pd.read_csv("regions.csv")
extra["aois"] = pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def evidence(case, index, df, user_df, legs, visits, extra):
    import json
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.4, 5.0), constrained_layout=True)
    moving = user_df[user_df.activity_state.eq('travelling')].copy()
    done = df[df.status.eq('completed')].copy()
    value = {}
    if case == 21:
        order = ['primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential']
        moving = moving.merge(legs[['leg_id', 'period']], on='leg_id', validate='many_to_one')
        if index == 1:
            summary = moving.groupby('fclass')[['step_distance_km', 'step_duration_s']].sum().reindex(order)
            summary['movement_speed_kmh'] = summary.step_distance_km/summary.step_duration_s*3600
            summary['completions'] = done.delivery_fclass.value_counts().reindex(order, fill_value=0)

            inset.title.set_fontsize(8);inset.tick_params(labelsize=7)
            inset.set_xticks([8,10,12],['08:00','10:00','12:00'])
            ax.text(.03,.85,f'Main view: ratio 0.9–3.25; {int(timed.route_directness_ratio.gt(3.25).sum())} higher outlier in inset\nTrend requires ≥8 legs from ≥3 days per window; no interpolation',
                transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=8,va='top')

            value = {'region_period_means': summary.reset_index().to_dict('records'),

        else:

                    'legs': len(q), 'oneway_share_unique_values': q.oneway_share.nunique(),
                    'route_ratio_unique_values': q.route_directness_ratio.nunique()}
                axis.set(title=f'{name}\nPearson r = {values[name]["pearson"]:.2f}; Spearman ρ = {values[name]["spearman"]:.2f}',
                    xlabel='One-way-road share of travelled distance (%)',xlim=(-3,103),ylim=(.9,3.25))
                axis.text(.03,.96,f'n = {len(q)}; main view: ratio 0.9–3.25\n{int(q.route_directness_ratio.gt(3.25).sum())} higher outlier(s); full range below',
                    transform=axis.transAxes,va='top',fontsize=8)
                inset=axis.inset_axes([.08,.47,.38,.34])
                inset.scatter(q.oneway_share*100,q.route_directness_ratio,color=color,s=5,alpha=.5)
                inset.set(xlim=(-3,103),ylim=(.9,float(legs.route_directness_ratio.max())+.5),title='Full range (all legs)')
                inset.title.set_fontsize(8);inset.tick_params(labelsize=6)
                axis.grid(alpha=.15)
            axes[0].set_ylabel('Travelled / straight-line distance\nHigher = more detour')
            axes[1].tick_params(labelleft=True)
            value = {'within_region_associations': values}
    ax.grid(alpha=.15)
    return json.loads(json.dumps(value, default=lambda x: x.item()))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
legs = pd.read_csv("movement_legs.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("aoi_visits.csv")
extra = {}
extra["regions"] = pd.read_csv("regions.csv")
extra["aois"] = pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def evidence(case, index, df, user_df, legs, visits, extra):
    import json
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.4, 5.0), constrained_layout=True)
    moving = user_df[user_df.activity_state.eq('travelling')].copy()
    done = df[df.status.eq('completed')].copy()
    value = {}
    if case == 21:
        order = ['primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential']
        moving = moving.merge(legs[['leg_id', 'period']], on='leg_id', validate='many_to_one')
        if index == 1:
            summary = moving.groupby('fclass')[['step_distance_km', 'step_duration_s']].sum().reindex(order)
            summary['movement_speed_kmh'] = summary.step_distance_km/summary.step_duration_s*3600
            summary['completions'] = done.delivery_fclass.value_counts().reindex(order, fill_value=0)
            summary['completions_per_km'] = summary.completions/summary.step_distance_km
            ax.bar(order, summary.movement_speed_kmh, color='#5c8ea7', alpha=.8, label='Movement speed')
            twin = ax.twinx(); twin.plot(order, summary.completions_per_km, 'o-', color='#bd7843')
            ax.set(ylabel='Distance / moving time (km/h)', xlabel='Native OSM fclass')
            twin.set_ylabel('Delivery completions per travelled km', color='#bd7843')
            value = {'road_class_summary': summary.to_dict('index')}
        elif index == 2:
            summary = moving.groupby(['period', 'fclass']).step_distance_km.sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
            summary = summary.div(summary.sum(axis=1), axis=0).reindex(['early', 'late'])
            summary[order].plot.bar(stacked=True, ax=ax, rot=0)
            ax.set(ylabel='Share of all moving distance', xlabel='First / second half of scheduled delivery stops')
            tasks = done.merge(legs[['leg_id', 'period']], left_on='arrival_leg_id', right_on='leg_id')
            value = {'distance_shares': summary.to_dict('index'), 'completion_counts': tasks.period.value_counts().to_dict()}
        else:
            # Smooth spatial AND temporal event kernel, independently measured
            # from task-completion positions/times rather than a generator label.
            frames = []
            for tid, q in moving.groupby('trajectory_id'):
                t = done[done.trajectory_id.eq(tid)]
                x = q[['lng', 'lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2, 111]
                y = t[['delivery_lng', 'delivery_lat']].to_numpy()*[95.2, 111]
                ds = np.linalg.norm(x[:, None]-y[None, :], axis=2)
                a = pd.to_datetime(q.gps_time, format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
                b = pd.to_datetime(t.completion_time, format='mixed').astype('int64').to_numpy()
                dt = abs(a[:, None]-b[None, :])/6e10
                q = q.copy(); q['nearby_activity'] = (np.exp(-ds/.30)*np.exp(-dt/30)).sum(axis=1)
                frames.append(q)
            points = pd.concat(frames); values = {}
            for cls in order:
                q = points[points.fclass.eq(cls)]
                bins = pd.qcut(q.nearby_activity, 5, duplicates='drop')
                med = q.groupby(bins, observed=True)[['nearby_activity', 'speed_kmh']].median()
                line = ax.plot(med.nearby_activity, med.speed_kmh, 'o-', label=cls)[0]
                sample = q.sample(min(350, len(q)), random_state=17)
                ax.scatter(sample.nearby_activity, sample.speed_kmh, s=6, alpha=.10, color=line.get_color())
                values[cls] = {'points': len(q), 'spearman': q.nearby_activity.corr(q.speed_kmh, method='spearman'),
                    'low_to_high_activity_speed_drop_kmh': med.speed_kmh.iloc[0]-med.speed_kmh.iloc[-1],
                    'quintile_medians': med.to_dict('list')}
            ax.set(xlabel='Nearby completion intensity (300 m / 30 min exponential kernel)', ylabel='Median moving speed (km/h)'); ax.legend()
            value = {'within_class_evidence': values}
    elif case == 22:
        if index == 1:
            counts = done.groupby(['service_date', 'aoi_id']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
            span = user_df.groupby('trajectory_id').gps_time.agg(['min', 'max'])
            duration = (pd.to_datetime(span['max'], format='mixed')-pd.to_datetime(span['min'], format='mixed')).dt.total_seconds()
            shares = visits.groupby(['trajectory_id', 'aoi_id']).duration_s.sum().unstack(fill_value=0).div(duration, axis=0)
            summary = pd.DataFrame({'mean_deliveries_per_day': counts.mean(), 'mean_work_time_share': shares.mean()})
            summary.plot.bar(y='mean_deliveries_per_day', ax=ax, rot=0, legend=False, color='#608ea4')
            ax.set(ylabel='Completed deliveries per observed day', xlabel='Constructed AOI')
            twin = ax.twinx(); twin.plot(np.arange(len(summary)), summary.mean_work_time_share*100, 'o-', color='#bd7843'); twin.set_ylabel('Mean observed workday time (%)')
            value = {'aoi_summary': summary.to_dict('index'), 'observed_days': counts.shape[0],
                'regular_destination_fclasses': sorted(done[done.regular_aoi.eq('yes')].delivery_fclass.unique().tolist()),
                'fixed_receipt_sites': extra['receipt_events'].groupby('aoi_id')[['lng', 'lat']].nunique().to_dict('index')}
        elif index == 2:
            q = legs[legs.purpose.eq('delivery')]
            plt.close(fig)
            fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.4),constrained_layout=True);ax=axes[0]
            ax.boxplot([q[q.period.eq(p)].route_directness_ratio for p in ['early','late']],
                tick_labels=['Early','Late'])
            ax.set(xlabel='Delivery route phase',ylabel='Travelled / straight-line distance',
                title='Later delivery routes are more direct\nLower ratio = less detour')
            dates=sorted(q.service_date.unique())
            totals=moving.groupby('service_date')[['step_distance_km','step_duration_s']].sum()
            baseline=totals.step_distance_km/totals.step_duration_s*3600
            late=q[q.period.eq('late')].copy()
            late['day_mean_movement_speed_kmh']=late.service_date.map(baseline)
            late['difference_from_day_mean_kmh']=late.mean_speed_kmh-late.day_mean_movement_speed_kmh
            above=late.difference_from_day_mean_kmh.gt(0)
            x=late.service_date.map({day:i for i,day in enumerate(dates)}).to_numpy(dtype=float)
            x+=np.where(late.groupby('service_date').cumcount().eq(0),-.12,.12)
            axes[1].axhline(0,color='#555555',linewidth=1,linestyle='--',label='Same as day mean')
            for mask,color,label in [(above,'#3976a8','Above day mean'),(~above,'#c77c3d','At or below day mean')]:
                axes[1].scatter(x[mask],late.loc[mask,'difference_from_day_mean_kmh'],color=color,s=48,
                    label=f'{label}: {int(mask.sum())}/{len(late)} ({mask.mean():.1%})')
            axes[1].set(xticks=np.arange(len(dates)),xticklabels=[day[5:] for day in dates],
                xlabel='Workday — each point is a delivery leg as time drew to a close',ylabel='Leg speed − day mean movement speed (km/h)',
                title='As time drew to a close:\nMore direct does not guarantee above-average speed')
            axes[1].margins(y=.30)
            axes[1].tick_params(axis='x',rotation=45,labelsize=8)
            axes[1].legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=8,frameon=False)
            axes[1].grid(axis='y',alpha=.15)
            value = {'period_means': q.groupby('period')[['route_directness_ratio', 'mean_speed_kmh']].mean().to_dict('index'),
                'day_mean_definition':'All moving GPS distance / all moving GPS time, including return legs and excluding stops',
                'daily_mean_movement_speed_kmh':baseline.to_dict(),
                'late_delivery_legs':len(late),'late_legs_above_day_mean':int(above.sum()),
                'late_share_above_day_mean':float(above.mean()),
                'late_leg_comparison':late[['leg_id','service_date','mean_speed_kmh','day_mean_movement_speed_kmh','difference_from_day_mean_kmh']].to_dict('records')}
        elif index == 3:
            q = done.copy(); stamp = pd.to_datetime(q.completion_time, format='mixed')
            q['completion_hour'] = stamp.dt.hour+stamp.dt.minute/60+stamp.dt.second/3600
            q['window_hours'] = (pd.to_datetime(q.time_window_end)-pd.to_datetime(q.time_window_start)).dt.total_seconds()/3600
            plt.close(fig)
            fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.5),constrained_layout=True);ax=axes[0]
            groups=[q[q.regular_aoi.eq('no')&q.window_hours.lt(9)],
                    q[q.regular_aoi.eq('no')&q.window_hours.ge(9)],q[q.regular_aoi.eq('yes')&q.window_hours.ge(9)]]
            labels=['Non-regular AOIs\nWindow <9 h','Non-regular AOIs\nWindow ≥9 h','Regular AOIs (A/B)\nWindow ≥9 h']
            colors=['#4f846c','#3976a8','#c77c3d']
            boxes=ax.boxplot([g.completion_hour for g in groups],tick_labels=labels,patch_artist=True)
            for box,color in zip(boxes['boxes'],colors):box.set_facecolor(color);box.set_alpha(.45)
            for i,g in enumerate(groups,1):
                median=g.completion_hour.median();h=int(median);minute=int(round((median-h)*60))
                ax.text(i,17.8,f'n={len(g)}\nMedian {h:02}:{minute:02}',ha='center',fontsize=9)
            ax.set(ylabel='Task completion time (Shanghai)',title='Both non-regular window groups finish earlier',ylim=(7.5,18.5))
            ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v,_:f'{int(v):02}:00')
            ax.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=8)
            for g,label,color,marker in zip(groups,labels,colors,['o','s','^']):
                axes[1].scatter(g.window_hours,g.completion_hour,s=16,alpha=.45,
                    color=color,marker=marker,label=label.replace('\n','; '))
            axes[1].set(xlabel='Service-window duration (hours)',ylabel='Task completion time (Shanghai)',
                title='Wide windows alone do not explain later completion',ylim=(7.5,19.5))
            axes[1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v,_:f'{int(v):02}:00')
            axes[1].legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=8,frameon=False)
            axes[1].grid(alpha=.15)
            nvisits = visits.groupby(['service_date', 'aoi_id']).size()
            value = {'group_medians': q.groupby('regular_aoi')[['completion_hour', 'window_hours']].median().to_dict('index'),

grid = np.linspace(0,1,101)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.8),constrained_layout=True)
modes=['walking','cycling','public_transit','motor_vehicle']
colors=['#16a34a','#7c3aed','#0f766e','#ea580c']
axes[0].boxplot([df[df.mode_group.eq(m)].avg_speed_kmh for m in modes],tick_labels=[m.replace('_',' ') for m in modes])
axes[0].set(title='Typical trip speeds within each mode',ylabel='trip mean speed (km/h)');axes[0].tick_params(axis='x',rotation=25)
for mode,color in zip(modes,colors):
    profiles=[]; accelerations=[]
    for _,g in user_df[user_df.mode_group.eq(mode)].groupby('trajectory_id'):
        g=g.sort_values('point_index'); times=pd.to_datetime(g.timestamp,format='mixed'); seconds=(times-times.iloc[0]).dt.total_seconds().to_numpy(); progress=seconds/seconds[-1]
        v=g.speed_kmh.to_numpy(); acceleration=np.diff(v)/3.6/np.diff(seconds)
        profiles.append(np.interp(grid,progress,v));accelerations.append(np.interp(grid,(progress[1:]+progress[:-1])/2,acceleration))
    for ax,data in [(axes[1],profiles),(axes[2],accelerations)]:
        values=np.array(data); ax.fill_between(grid,np.quantile(values,.1,axis=0),np.quantile(values,.9,axis=0),color=color,alpha=.15)
        ax.plot(grid,np.median(values,axis=0),color=color,label=mode.replace('_',' '));ax.grid(alpha=.2)
axes[1].set(title='Within-mode speed rhythms (median, 10–90%)',xlabel='fraction of elapsed trip time',ylabel='speed (km/h)')
axes[2].set(title='Acceleration derived from speed and time',xlabel='fraction of elapsed trip time',ylabel='acceleration (m/s²)')
axes[1].legend(fontsize=8);axes[2].axhline(0,color='gray',lw=.7)
print(df.groupby('mode_group').avg_speed_kmh.agg(['mean','std','min','max']).round(3))
plt.show()

import pandas as pd

d = df.copy()

plt.ylabel('Average speed (km/h)')

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

modes = ["walking", "car"]
colors = ["#2ca25f", "#3182bd"]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5), constrained_layout=True)
rng = np.random.default_rng(101)
for ax, column, ylabel, title in [
 (axes[0], "avg_speed_kmh", "Average speed (km/h)", "Speed distribution by movement mode"),
 (axes[1], "detour_score", "Route-indirectness score", "Route-indirectness distribution by movement mode"),
]:
 values = [df.loc[df["travel_mode"].eq(mode), column].dropna().to_numpy() for mode in modes]
 ax.boxplot(values, tick_labels=[m.title() for m in modes], patch_artist=True)
 for x, (mode, color, vals) in enumerate(zip(modes, colors, values), 1):
 jitter = rng.normal(x, 0.045, size=len(vals))
 ax.scatter(jitter, vals, s=34, alpha=0.82, color=color, edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5, label=mode.title())
 ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
 ax.set_title(title)
 ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
 if column == "avg_speed_kmh":
 ax.set_yscale("log")
 ax.legend(frameon=False)
fig.suptitle("Speed and Route-Indirectness Distributions by Movement Mode")
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

points = pd.read_csv(user_dataset_path)
target = points[points["trajectory_id"].eq(4739000)].sort_values("point_index").copy()
threshold = 35.0
drift = target[target["matched_distance"] > threshold]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.5), constrained_layout=True)
axes[0].plot(target["longitude"], target["latitude"], color="#9ca3af", label="Observed GPS path")
axes[0].scatter(target["matched_longitude"], target["matched_latitude"], color="#1d4ed8", s=7, alpha=0.35, label="WorldTrace matched-reference points")
axes[0].scatter(drift["longitude"], drift["latitude"], color="#dc2626", s=18, label=f"GPS points > {threshold:.0f} m from match")
axes[0].set_title("Observed path and matched-reference points")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Longitude"); axes[0].set_ylabel("Latitude"); axes[0].axis("equal"); axes[0].legend(frameon=False)
axes[1].plot(target["point_index"], target["matched_distance"], color="#374151")
axes[1].scatter(drift["point_index"], drift["matched_distance"], color="#dc2626", s=18)
axes[1].axhline(threshold, color="#dc2626", linestyle="--", label=f"Drift threshold ({threshold:.0f} m)")
axes[1].set_title("Distance to matching reference along the trajectory")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Point index"); axes[1].set_ylabel("Distance to matching reference (m)"); axes[1].grid(alpha=0.25); axes[1].legend(frameon=False)
fig.suptitle("GPS Drift Evidence for Trajectory 4739000")
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df=pd.read_csv(dataset_path)
derived=[]
for tid,g in df.groupby('trajectory_id'):
    g=g.sort_values('point_index');x=np.radians(g.longitude.to_numpy());y=np.radians(g.latitude.to_numpy())
    a=np.sin(np.diff(y)/2)**2+np.cos(y[:-1])*np.cos(y[1:])*np.sin(np.diff(x)/2)**2
    km=6371.0088*2*np.arcsin(np.sqrt(np.clip(a,0,1)))
    seconds=pd.to_datetime(g.timestamp,format='mixed').diff().dt.total_seconds().to_numpy()[1:]
    derived.append({'trajectory_id':tid,'distance_meters':float(km.sum()*1000),'avg_speed_kmh':float(km.sum()/seconds.sum()*3600)})
summary=pd.DataFrame(derived)
print(summary.sort_values('avg_speed_kmh',ascending=False))

import pandas as pd

summary = df.drop_duplicates("trajectory_id").copy()
is_ab = (((summary["start_region"] == "Area A (South Brooklyn)") & (summary["end_region"] == "Area B (Lower Manhattan)")) | ((summary["start_region"] == "Area B (Lower Manhattan)") & (summary["end_region"] == "Area A (South Brooklyn)")))
summary["trajectory_group"] = is_ab.map({True: "Area A–Area B corridor", False: "Other trajectories"})
summary["direction"] = "Other"
summary.loc[(summary["start_region"] == "Area A (South Brooklyn)") & (summary["end_region"] == "Area B (Lower Manhattan)"), "direction"] = "A to B"
summary.loc[(summary["start_region"] == "Area B (Lower Manhattan)") & (summary["end_region"] == "Area A (South Brooklyn)"), "direction"] = "B to A"

report = pd.DataFrame({"count": [len(summary), int(is_ab.sum()), int((~is_ab).sum()), int((summary["direction"] == "A to B").sum()), int((summary["direction"] == "B to A").sum())]}, index=["All trajectories", "Area A–Area B corridor", "Other trajectories", "A to B", "B to A"])
report["share"] = report["count"] / len(summary)
print(report)
report.loc[["Area A–Area B corridor", "Other trajectories"]]["count"].plot(kind="bar", color="slateblue")
plt.title("Share of Trajectories in the Area A–Area B Corridor")
plt.ylabel("Number of trajectories")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

summary = df.drop_duplicates("trajectory_id").copy()
is_ab = (((summary["start_region"] == "Area A (South Brooklyn)") & (summary["end_region"] == "Area B (Lower Manhattan)")) | ((summary["start_region"] == "Area B (Lower Manhattan)") & (summary["end_region"] == "Area A (South Brooklyn)")))
ab_ids = set(summary.loc[is_ab, "trajectory_id"])
route_points = df[df["trajectory_id"].isin(ab_ids)].sort_values(["trajectory_id", "point_index"])

def corridor_family(trajectory_id):
 number = int(trajectory_id.rsplit("_", 1)[1])
 return (number - 1) % 6 if number <= 18 else ((number - 19) + 1) % 6

route_points["corridor_family"] = route_points["trajectory_id"].map(corridor_family)
palette = ["#2563eb", "#dc2626", "#16a34a", "#9333ea", "#ea580c", "#0891b2"]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))
for trajectory_id, trip in route_points.groupby("trajectory_id"):
 family = int(trip["corridor_family"].iloc[0])
 axes[0].plot(trip["longitude"], trip["latitude"], color=palette[family], alpha=0.12, linewidth=0.8)
for family, group in route_points.groupby("corridor_family"):
 family_ids = group["trajectory_id"].drop_duplicates().tolist()
 for trajectory_id in family_ids[:2]:
  trip = group[group["trajectory_id"] == trajectory_id]
  label = f"Corridor {int(family)+1}" if trajectory_id == family_ids[0] else None
  axes[0].plot(trip["longitude"], trip["latitude"], color=palette[int(family)], alpha=0.9, linewidth=2.8, label=label)
axes[0].set_title("Repeated Area A–Area B Route Corridors")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Longitude"); axes[0].set_ylabel("Latitude")
axes[0].legend(frameon=False, ncol=2)
for family, group in route_points.groupby("corridor_family"):
 values = group.drop_duplicates("trajectory_id")["distance_meters"].astype(float)
 axes[1].scatter(np.full(len(values), int(family)) + np.random.default_rng(int(family)).normal(0, 0.06, len(values)), values, color=palette[int(family)], alpha=0.75, s=28)
axes[1].set_xticks(range(6), [f"C{i}" for i in range(1, 7)])
axes[1].set_title("Distance Variation within Route Families")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Repeated route family"); axes[1].set_ylabel("Traveled distance (m)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ordered = df.sort_values(["trajectory_id", "point_index"])
summary = ordered.drop_duplicates("trajectory_id")
is_main = summary["trajectory_id"].str.startswith("user051_main_")
main_ids = set(summary.loc[is_main, "trajectory_id"])

def corridor_family(trajectory_id):
 number = int(trajectory_id.rsplit("_", 1)[1])
 return (number - 1) % 6 if number <= 18 else ((number - 19) + 1) % 6

route_endpoints = []
for trajectory_id, group in ordered.groupby("trajectory_id"):
 first, last = group.iloc[0], group.iloc[-1]
 gap = ((float(last["latitude"]) - float(first["latitude"])) ** 2 + (float(last["longitude"]) - float(first["longitude"])) ** 2) ** 0.5
 route_endpoints.append((trajectory_id, gap))
loop_id = min(route_endpoints, key=lambda item: item[1])[0]
palette = ["#2563eb", "#dc2626", "#16a34a", "#9333ea", "#ea580c", "#0891b2"]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(15, 6))
for trajectory_id, trip in ordered[ordered["trajectory_id"].isin(main_ids)].groupby("trajectory_id"):
 family = corridor_family(trajectory_id)
 axes[0].plot(trip["longitude"], trip["latitude"], color=palette[family], alpha=0.18, linewidth=0.9)
for family in range(6):
 family_ids = sorted(tid for tid in main_ids if corridor_family(tid) == family)
 for trajectory_id in family_ids[:2]:
  trip = ordered[ordered["trajectory_id"] == trajectory_id]
  label = f"Corridor {family+1} ({len(family_ids)} trips)" if trajectory_id == family_ids[0] else None
  axes[0].plot(trip["longitude"], trip["latitude"], color=palette[family], linewidth=3.0, alpha=0.9, label=label)
for trajectory_id, trip in ordered.groupby("trajectory_id"):
 if trajectory_id == loop_id:
  color, width, alpha = "#dc2626", 4.0, 0.95
 elif trajectory_id in main_ids:
  color, width, alpha = palette[corridor_family(trajectory_id)], 1.6, 0.45
 else:
  color, width, alpha = "#64748b", 1.8, 0.8
 axes[1].plot(trip["longitude"], trip["latitude"], color=color, linewidth=width, alpha=alpha)
 axes[1].scatter(trip["longitude"].iloc[0], trip["latitude"].iloc[0], color=color, marker="o", s=18, alpha=alpha)
 axes[1].scatter(trip["longitude"].iloc[-1], trip["latitude"].iloc[-1], color=color, marker="s", s=18, alpha=alpha)
loop = ordered[ordered["trajectory_id"] == loop_id]
axes[1].scatter(loop["longitude"].iloc[0], loop["latitude"].iloc[0], color="navy", marker="*", s=110, label=f"Closed loop: {loop_id}", zorder=5)
axes[0].set_title("36 Corridor Trajectories: Six Repeated Route Families")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Longitude"); axes[0].set_ylabel("Latitude"); axes[0].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, ncol=2)
axes[1].set_title("All 40 Trajectories: One Closed Loop")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Longitude"); axes[1].set_ylabel("Latitude")
axes[1].text(0.02, 0.02, "Circles = starts; squares = ends. Gray routes have distinct endpoints.", transform=axes[1].transAxes, fontsize=8, color="#475569")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

cold_rain = df[df.weather_condition.eq("rainy") & df.temperature_2m_c.between(2, 6)]
car = cold_rain[cold_rain.travel_mode.eq("car")].sort_values("distance_meters")
short = car[car.distance_meters < 1500]
medium = car[car.distance_meters.between(1500, 4000, inclusive="left")]
long = car[car.distance_meters >= 4000]
mode_counts = cold_rain.travel_mode.value_counts().reindex(["car", "walking"], fill_value=0)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5.1), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1, 2.2]})
axes[0].bar(mode_counts.index, mode_counts.values, color=["#4477aa", "#ee9944"], width=0.55)
for i, value in enumerate(mode_counts):
    axes[0].text(i, value+0.2, str(value), ha="center", fontsize=12)
axes[0].set(title="Trajectories by mode", ylabel="Number of trajectories", ylim=(0, 14))
km = car.distance_meters.to_numpy()/1000
colors = ["#4477aa" if v<1.5 else "#ddaa33" if v<4 else "#cc6677" for v in km]
axes[1].bar(np.arange(len(car)), km, color=colors, width=0.7)
for i, value in enumerate(km):
    axes[1].text(i, value+0.06, f"{value:g}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
axes[1].axhline(km.mean(), color="#222222", ls="--", lw=1.2, label=f"All {len(car)} car trips: mean {km.mean():.3f} km")
axes[1].set_xticks(np.arange(len(car)), [x.removeprefix("wt7_") for x in car.trajectory_id], rotation=40)
axes[1].set(title=f"{len(short)} short, {len(medium)} medium and {len(long)} long car trips", xlabel="Trajectory ID (wt7_ prefix omitted)", ylabel="Distance (km)", ylim=(0, 6.2))
axes[1].legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=10, frameon=False)
fig.suptitle("Cold rain (2-6°C): mode counts and individual car distances", fontsize=14)
fig.text(0.5, 0.015, "Display bands: short <1.5 km; medium 1.5-<4 km; long >=4 km.", ha="center", fontsize=10)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.05, 1, 0.95))
plt.show()

groups = [short, medium, long, car]
means = [g.distance_meters.mean()/1000 for g in groups]
labels = [f"Short car trips\n(n={len(short)}, <1.5 km)", f"Medium car trips\n(n={len(medium)}, 1.5-<4 km)", f"Long car trips\n(n={len(long)}, >=4 km)", f"All cold-rain car trips\n(n={len(car)})"]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 5.1))
ax.bar(labels, means, color=["#4477aa", "#ddaa33", "#cc6677", "#339988"], width=0.6)
for i, value in enumerate(means):
    ax.text(i, value+0.08, f"{value:.3f} km", ha="center", fontsize=12)
ax.set(title="How the short trips affect the overall car mean", ylabel="Mean trajectory distance (km)", ylim=(0, 5.5))
formula = f"Weighted mean: ({len(short)} × {means[0]:.4f} + {len(medium)} × {means[1]:.4f} + {len(long)} × {means[2]:.4f}) / {len(car)} = {means[3]:.4f} km"
fig.text(0.5, 0.025, formula, ha="center", fontsize=10)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.075, 1, 1))
plt.show()

order=['north↔southwest','south↔north','northwest↔southeast','northeast↔southwest'];periods=['night','morning','midday','evening']
d=df.copy();d['hour']=d.departure_time.dt.hour;d['date']=d.departure_time.dt.strftime('%m-%d');d['period']=pd.cut(d.hour,[-1,5,11,16,23],labels=periods)
tab=pd.crosstab(d.movement_direction,d.period).reindex(index=order,columns=periods,fill_value=0)
tab=tab.loc[:,tab.sum().gt(0)]
share=tab.div(tab.sum(axis=0).replace(0,np.nan),axis=1).mul(100).fillna(0)
evening=d[d.period.eq('evening')];daily=pd.crosstab(evening.movement_direction,evening.date).reindex(index=order,fill_value=0)
print('Trajectory counts by period');print(tab);print('Within-period shares (%)');print(share.round(1));print('Evening counts by date');print(daily)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,8),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1,1.25]},constrained_layout=True)
im=ax[0].imshow(share,cmap='YlGnBu',aspect='auto',vmin=0,vmax=100)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(share.columns)),share.columns);ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(order)),order)
ax[0].set_xlabel('time period');ax[0].set_title('Direction share within each time period')
for row in range(len(order)):
    for col in range(len(share.columns)):
        value=share.iloc[row,col];ax[0].text(col,row,f'{tab.iloc[row,col]} trips\n{value:.0f}%',ha='center',va='center',color='white' if value>55 else 'black')
im2=ax[1].imshow(daily,cmap='Oranges',aspect='auto',vmin=0,vmax=max(2,daily.to_numpy().max()))
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(daily.columns)),daily.columns,rotation=60,ha='right');ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(order)),order)
ax[1].set_xlabel('date');ax[1].set_title('Evening trajectories by direction on each observed date')
for row in range(len(order)):
    for col in range(len(daily.columns)):
        value=daily.iloc[row,col]
        if value: ax[1].text(col,row,str(value),ha='center',va='center',fontweight='bold')
fig.colorbar(im,ax=ax[0],label='share within time period (%)');fig.colorbar(im2,ax=ax[1],label='evening trajectory count');plt.show()

def substantial_turns(q,threshold=20):
    q=q.sort_values('point_index');lat=q.matched_road_latitude.to_numpy();lon=q.matched_road_longitude.to_numpy()
    east=np.diff(lon)*np.cos(np.deg2rad(lat.mean()));north=np.diff(lat);moving=np.hypot(east,north)>1e-10
    headings=np.degrees(np.arctan2(east[moving],north[moving]));changes=np.abs((np.diff(headings)+180)%360-180)
    return int((changes>threshold).sum())
turns=pd.Series({tid:substantial_turns(q) for tid,q in user_df.groupby('trajectory_id')},name='substantial_turn_count')

geometry['turns_per_km']=geometry.substantial_turn_count/geometry.trajectory_distance_km

current_case_revisions.note: Case geometry and evidence repaired while preserving authored insight text. Quiet-window dispersion uses complete long routes; spatial grouping does not depend on track length. Current input dependencies remain unchanged. Historical model evaluations refer to the pre-repair case.

metric_provenance.reason: Speed is native metadata Distance / Time; mode is a threshold of this speed, so it adds no separate input. Detour uses Distance and endpoint coordinates. Metadata duration is already a source quantity; do not manufacture two event times.
The supplied detour and mode columns came from the same source-index formulas as case 01. Endpoint coordinates are upstream in the source index, even though the final case only exports a summary CSV.

The current repair recomputes path distance, detour and mean speed from delivered GPS and elapsed time. Group points by trajectory. Departure period and elapsed time use the same timestamp column and count once.
This claim uses avg_speed_kmh, which was explicitly repaired to GPS distance / elapsed timestamp duration. Independently assigned point speed is not the measurement used for this claim.

The speed/distance/time comparison uses assigned trip distance and travel time; ordinary mean speed is a ratio of those quantities. Speed-profile variability is an additional independently specified speed input, rather than GPS/time speed. Do not assert the assigned summary distances can be recovered from the illustrative path.

synchronize_kinematics computes mean speed and distance from matched-road coordinates and timestamps. The walking extent is endpoint displacement on that same geometry. The car claim also needs independent point speeds for variability and both observed and matched positions for positioning offsets.

Mean speed uses matched-road path/time; local turn and point-speed comparisons retain the independently assigned speed profile. Distance and turn geometry come from matched positions, not an extra raw-position dimension.

Mean speed and travel duration require timestamps and matched geometry; within-trip speed SD requires the independently assigned speed profile. Peak period and elapsed duration are derived from the same timestamp column. Directness adds no input beyond the matched geometry already counted.

The authored comparison bins trajectories by mean speed (matched distance / elapsed time) and compares braking frequency derived from point-speed changes over time. Both mean-speed and braking inputs are necessary.

The authored footprint is the convex hull of matched-road positions; low mean speed is matched distance / elapsed time. Point-speed variation is not part of this claim. Day type and duration reuse the timestamp dimension.

The summary mean speed is independently assigned; the plotted directness comes from the underlying matched route before raw GPS offsets are added. Preserve the speed as an additional input, not as an original WorldTrace measurement.

Point speeds are explicitly distance / allocated elapsed seconds; trip means are route distance / duration. Departure-time strata and elapsed duration reuse one timestamp stream; a speed dimension is not counted on top.

Stored mean speed is route distance / duration; point_rows also computes speed from displacement and elapsed seconds. Keep the matched-comparison key where the complete claim calls for comparable trips.

Both mean speed and its driver-level variation are based on distance/duration speed, and point speeds use the same kinematically consistent point_rows. Directness reuses geometry and adds no separate dimension.

metric_provenance.decision: Speed profiles / average speed are assigned independently. Count a speed input but label it added, never source-native.
Speed, yaw and detour are assigned arguments; there is no GPS table. They are added independent inputs, not native or geometry-derived measurements.
Independently generated or edited point-speed values remain added inputs. Mean/SD computed from these values inherit that speed input; GPS/time means are handled separately above.
The supplied speed profiles are assigned and are not displacement/time calculations. They are additional independent speed inputs.
